description:
**About the company**### **Tomorrow University: A Next\-Generation University for Impactful Careers**


Education is the most powerful lever for driving the transition to a sustainable society. That’s why we’ve built a university dedicated to educating and empowering the change\-makers of tomorrow. We offer accredited degree programs designed to equip learners with 21st\-century competencies while providing access to a world\-class network of experts to maximize their impact.


As a remote\-first institution, we use technology and AI to enable flexible, personalized learning \- accessible from anywhere in the world.


We are proud to be the first EdTech startup in Europe with a fully state\-recognized university license and to be ranked among the **Top 20 EdTech startups globally**.

### **Our Inspiration**


We believe that transforming education requires rethinking how we teach. At Tomorrow University, we move beyond the traditional, teacher\-centered approach and embrace **a student\-centric learning model**. Our goal is to equip learners with the essential skills and mindset needed to create global impact, supported by a vast network of change\-makers.

### **Our Mission**


At Tomorrow University, we leverage **science and technology** to enhance learning while fostering a global community for continuous growth and impact. Our students learn by **applying their knowledge to real\-world challenges** and engaging with world\-class educators, mentors, and partners from around the globe.

**Be aware that all of our positions are completely Remote but our working hours are Central European Time (\+/\- 2h)**

**About the role**
The marketing team works across three growth levers: **create demand, acquire demand, convert demand.** Four people own that work between them. **You own create demand.**


Your job is to make more of the right people want a Tomorrow University degree.


Choosing a degree is a slow, expensive, high\-trust decision. People discover us, come back weeks later, attend an event, compare options, worry about cost, and take time to decide. Your work gives them a reason to pay attention and helps build the confidence to take the next step.


You set the content strategy and produce much of the work yourself. You decide what we say, who we say it to, which formats and channels we use, and what is worth testing. Most weeks, that also means writing, filming, editing, or building the asset.


You have support. Part\-time creators help increase output once we know what works, and our designer supports the work that needs stronger craft or brand treatment.


We are looking for someone who likes making things, putting them in market, and learning from the response. The goal is consistent demand creation, with a clear view of which ideas, messages, and formats are actually working.


What You'll Own


Make people want this degree

* Develop the content strategy across programs, markets, paid, organic, and social. You decide the ideas, the messages, the proof points behind them, and which audiences they are for.
* Turn our positioning into creative that people understand and remember. That means knowing how to express an idea through copy, design, photography, video, or a combination of them.
* Lead the creative for program launches and seasonal campaigns from first idea to execution.

  

Work at strategy level and make the work yourself


This is a small startup, so the role moves between strategy and execution all the time.

* You write exceptionally well and can take an idea from rough concept to finished asset yourself.
* You are comfortable designing in Figma or Canva, shooting photography, filming and editing video, and producing short\-form content for social and paid. You also know when a stronger piece needs a specialist.
* Freelancers and creators are there to support and scale the work, but you need enough creative range and judgement to direct them well.
* Use AI image and video tools where they are genuinely useful, alongside more traditional production.

  

Own social content strategy and creation


You own what we say on social and what we make for it.

* Set the social content strategy, generate the ideas, write the posts, develop recurring formats, and brief UGC creators.
* Produce the core content yourself and work with freelancers or creators where additional production is needed.
* Work closely with our part\-time Social Media Coordinator, who manages scheduling, publishing, engagement, commenting, and the day\-to\-day running of the channels.
* Build content with both organic and paid use in mind where it makes sense.

  

Test ideas and build on what works

* Work with Performance Marketing on a regular creative testing rhythm across messages, concepts, formats, and audiences.
* Keep a clear record of which angles work by program and market so future campaigns start with evidence.
* Decide what to test next, stop producing ideas that are not working, and develop the ones that are.
* Bring the useful learnings into the weekly review, including both the strong performers and the ideas that did not land.

  

What You Bring

* 7\+ years in performance creative, growth marketing, content, or social. You have spent a meaningful part of that time making the work yourself.
* You are an excellent writer across hooks, scripts, ad copy, captions, and campaign messaging, and you know how to change the writing when the format changes.
* Comfortable shooting and editing yourself, whether that is on a phone, a camera, or whatever else the idea needs.
* You can design well enough in Figma or Canva to make strong static assets without waiting on a designer for every piece.
* **Creative testing is part of how you work.** You can isolate a variable, read the result properly, and decide what to change next.
* You know how to direct creators, freelancers, coordinators, and designers once an idea is working. Clear briefs and useful feedback matter more than process.
* AI image and video tools are already part of your production workflow, and you have a good sense of when they help and when they do not.
* You are comfortable being measured on outcomes beyond reach or engagement, including applications and enrolled students.

You believe education can change lives.  
* 

  

Nice to have, not required:

* You speak German.
* You have worked in higher education, edtech, or another category with a long purchase decision.
* You have run creator or UGC programs.
* You can do motion design or advanced video editing.
* You are a strong photographer.
* You have worked on performance creative in a regulated category.

 **What Matters to Us**


We’re looking for people who thrive in a dynamic, mission\-driven environment. These traits are especially important to us:

* **Ownership \& Independence** – You take initiative and get things done
* **Collaborative Mindset** – You enjoy working across teams and disciplines
* **Clear \& Thoughtful Communication** – You know how to adapt your message to different audiences
* **Integrity, Curiosity \& Growth** – You’re honest, open\-minded, and always looking to learn
* **Proactivity \& Drive** – You bring energy and momentum to your work
* **Commitment to Execution** – You don’t just dream big—you make things happen
* **Passion for Sustainability, Entrepreneurship \& Technology** – You care deeply about building a better future

 **Perks \& Benefits**


**Grow with us**


At Tomorrow University, we foster lifelong learning. You’ll have access to our innovative programs and be part of a culture that encourages continuous growth, personally and professionally.


**Travel the world together**


Twice a year, we bring the whole team together for a week\-long Workation somewhere in Europe, think bonding, brainstorming, and big ideas in beautiful places.


**Time to recharge**


You’ll get **25 vacation days** per year, plus public holidays based on your location.

**Ready to shape the future of education and make an impact? Join us and help reimagine how we learn, grow, and build a better tomorrow.**


At Tomorrow University, we believe in your potential, not your paperwork. Degrees are great, but your *drive* matters even more

title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


As our Creative Strategist, you will own creative performance from audience insight through concept development, testing, and optimization, turning consumer behavior and performance data into creative strategies that drive measurable growth.


This is a highly hands\-on, analytical role for someone who combines strong creative instincts with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, customer psychology, and paid social performance. You’ll research audiences, develop new concepts and angles, analyze creative performance, and continuously identify opportunities to improve what we test and how we scale winning ideas.


At Acentecom, we believe the strongest creative strategies start with a deep understanding of the customer and evolve through continuous experimentation. We’re looking for someone who can connect audience insights, creative thinking, and performance data to make better decisions and drive stronger results.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* Develop a deep understanding of audiences, customer psychology, and market behavior, identifying pain points, desires, objections, beliefs, and emotional drivers and translating them into actionable creative opportunities.
* Build and continuously evolve a pipeline of creative concepts, hooks, angles, personas, messaging frameworks, and formats, ensuring ideas are grounded in audience insights and clear strategic hypotheses.
* Own creative performance analysis across paid social, using metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS to identify patterns, diagnose performance, and determine what to test next.
* Build structured creative testing and experimentation frameworks, isolating variables across hooks, visuals, scripts, messaging, and personas to understand what drives performance.
* Identify and scale winning creative patterns, systematically iterating on successful concepts while continuously introducing new hypotheses and testing opportunities.
* Partner closely with Media Buying, CRO, Copywriting, Video Editing, and Creative teams to connect creative performance with the broader funnel and translate cross\-functional insights into stronger advertising strategies.
* Guide and support Video Editors, providing clear strategic direction and performance\-based feedback around hooks, pacing, retention, engagement, and overall creative effectiveness.
* Turn research, testing results, and performance data into clear recommendations and next actions, maintaining visibility into key learnings, market trends, competitor activity, and opportunities for growth.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, customer psychology, consumer behavior, and paid social creative strategy.
* Strong hands\-on experience in e\-commerce, ideally DTC e\-commerce, within a high\-volume, performance\-driven environment.
* Strong experience in Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related performance\-driven creative role.
* Hands\-on experience analyzing Meta and paid social creative performance, with the ability to understand why creatives perform and translate that analysis into better concepts and testing decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with creative performance metrics, including hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS.
* Experience developing creative concepts, hooks, angles, messaging, personas, and testing hypotheses based on audience research and performance insights.
* Strong understanding of creative testing and experimentation, with experience building structured tests, interpreting results, and scaling winning concepts.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Triple Whale, or similar performance analytics platforms.
* Experience collaborating closely with Media Buyers, CRO teams, Copywriters, Video Editors, and creative production teams.
* A highly proactive and autonomous approach. You’re naturally curious, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to move from research to hypothesis to execution without requiring detailed direction.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, provide clear creative direction and feedback, and turn performance insights into actionable recommendations.

title: Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============


Creative Milkshake is a remote\-first performance creative agency. We make scroll\-stopping short\-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok \- high\-volume, fast\-moving, and built to convert.


We’re a close\-knit team of \~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing \- in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.


Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC\-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============


We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.


We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social \& UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands\-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.


You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15\-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================


For this role, we're only considering candidates based in \+/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

  

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands\-on creative direction in post**
---------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (\+\-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short\-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

  

**Who you are**
===============


We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands\-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social\-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short\-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on\-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

  

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================


There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post\-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in\-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands\-on with short\-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

  

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short\-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social\-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands\-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short\-form, social\-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people\-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

  

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare \& internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO \+ 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year\-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5\)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT US
  
  

Reach Digital is an AI\-first performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative, paid media, and landing pages. We are a true growth partner \- going deep with brands to become integrated into their marketing team. We drive real growth by combining data, testing, and new ideas.
  
  

We're a fully remote team of creatives, editors, and growth strategists. We care about the work, and care about being the best at what we do.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end\-to\-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.
  
  

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  

You have 2\+ years of digital marketing experience
  
  

You understand paid media and the types of content that converts
  
  

You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life
  
  

You are detail\-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  
  

You're willing to learn and get better even when that means giving and receiving feedback
  
  

You are comfortable communicating learnings with both team members and clients
  
  

You're genuinely passionate about creative strategy and staying on top of what's working \- you do this because you want to, not because you have to
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  
  

Analyzing performance, brainstorming ad angles and hook variations, and writing new briefs weekly for the editing team to produce
  
  

Owning the creative strategy for your brand partners, including a living strategy doc that tracks angles, performance, and what to test next
  
  

Staying current on platform trends, winning ad formats, and policy changes, and translating that into testable concepts for your accounts
  
  

Working with 3\-5 brand partners at a time, with a focus on going deep into their creative and building new winning ads
  
  

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM US
  
  

**Growth:** We invest in the people who invest in the work. Expect regular creative reviews, direct feedback, and room to grow into senior roles as Reach scales.
  
  

**Weekly Calls \& Creative Training:** Weekly team check\-ins, creative reviews and training sessions. Calls are typically held between 12pm–6pm EST on weekdays.
  
  

Generous PTO and benefits policy
  
  

Fully remote role (working US hours)
  
  

Competitive compensation in USD
  
  

The Hiring Process
  
  

All candidates will go through a 15\-minute questionnaire. Following this, top candidates will be given a culture fit interview before being given a paid, take\-home assignment.

title: Creative Producer
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.


Together with our network of talented creators, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.


As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content production, distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5\-Minute Crafts** and **Bright Side**.


We’re a dynamic, remote\-first global team, fostering award\-winning creativity, a no\-red\-tape approach, and great vibes!


We are looking to connect with experienced **Creative Producers** to lead creative content production for external clients and brands.


In these projects, you may manage the creative production process from brief to delivery, working directly with clients to understand their objectives, brand guidelines, and audience needs and translating them into effective social media content.


You will collaborate closely with creative and production teams, oversee the quality and consistency of deliverables, and help ensure that projects meet both client expectations and creative standards across a variety of formats and social platforms.

**Responsibilities:**
Depending on the scope and requirements of individual projects, responsibilities may include:

* Manage end\-to\-end production of video, static, and other social media content for external clients.
* Work directly with clients to understand their business objectives, creative needs, brand positioning, guidelines, and expectations.

Thousands of creators across our partner agencies post about Picsart's AI tools every week, and we're scaling that many times over. In this role, you decide what they make: the concepts, hooks, angles, scripts and briefs. You build rough examples in Picsart's own tools so creators and editors can see the idea instead of reading about it, and you run the tests that show which creative turns a viewer into someone who generates, spends credits and pays. You'll be working across all our social platforms: TikTok, Meta, Instagram, Youtube, X, and Reddit.

  



You work through AI, because nobody can watch that much content by hand. You'll use it to read everything the network publishes, to draft briefs and variations for every agency and creator, and to spot winners early, then you make the call and make the example. The best agencies now publish their playbooks; your edge is running that discipline across every agency at once, with the one dataset no agency has: what happens after the click.

  



How success looks like for this role within a year: conversion per view rising while volume rises, and winning creative replicating across markets in days.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-Time Contractor (12\-month contract) role.**



**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Decide what creators make.** The concepts, hooks and scripts they film each week. Agencies bring local ideas; you pick what the whole network runs.
* **Write briefs creators can follow.** Not documents they skim, clear direction, plus rough cuts and examples you make in Picsart's own tools, so nobody has to guess what you meant.
* **Test the creative.** Hook against hook, format against format, market against market. The results decide what runs next, not anyone's taste.
* **Get content finished.** Work directly with creators and editors to turn concepts into posts, and give feedback specific enough to act on.
* **Find out what converts.** Look at what thousands of videos actually did, and point the network at the audiences and use cases that bring in paying users.

* **Own launch content.** Every new model and feature goes out through the creator network within days. You decide what day one looks like.
* **Tell product what to build.** You see what people want from AI tools before product does. Turn that into concrete asks: which presets, templates and models to build or promote next.
* **Keep it fresh and safe.** Stop the whole network from copying last month's winner. And when a platform changes its rules or a theme crosses a trust\-and\-safety line, the network hears it from you first.

**Creative Director** 




 Live visuals across brand, music and culture
 



  





 Location: Central London studio, 5\-day week, 2\-3 days WFH
 



 Salary: £75,000
 



 Type: Permanent, Full\-time
 



  





**About rapt** 





 rapt is a multimedia studio making immersive and interactive experiences. A Projection show on a landmark building, LED at stage scale, real\-time visuals. One month a campaign launch in London, the next live visuals for an arena tour, the next an installation in a disused power station or the Nevada desert.
 




  






 We work with global brands, artists and cultural institutions. Previous names include BOSS, Nike, Valentino, McLaren, New Balance, TAG Heuer, Audemars Piguet, Netflix and Diageo. And the work doesn't stop with brands. We have an artistic practice of our own, and the self\-initiated work feeds back into everything else. The last thing we want an audience to feel is nothing.
 




  






 We're a small team working on big projects all over the world, and the studio is growing. This role plays a real part in shaping what it becomes next.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Creative Director to lead creative across pitches and live projects. Sharp conceptual thinking, a strong visual sensibility, and the ability to take an idea from first response through to what the audience actually experiences. Projects range from arena tours and festival main stages to building\-scale projection and gallery installations.
 



  





 This is a creative director with a producer's hat on. You need to know what it takes to make the idea real. Which people, how many days, what budget, what pipeline, and whether it lands on time. Not just the creative, but how realistic the creative is to deliver. You'll lead teams made up of internal people and external specialists, built per project from our freelance roster. You brief them, run them and sign off their work.
 



  





 You'll be running several pitches and several projects at the same time. Being highly organised isn't a nice\-to\-have here.
 



  





 You'll need to be fluent in immersive formats and creative technology, confident communicating ideas to clients and internal teams, and hands\-on enough to sketch, write or visualise ideas yourself when needed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Pitches* 



* Lead creative direction on pitch responses. Approach every brief strategically: what the objective is, who the audience is, and what the angle is that wins it.
* Translate briefs into clear creative strategy and strong, original ideas.
* Shape visual concepts, narratives and deck content.
* Scope the content side: team, days and cost, working with the project manager. If the idea can't be built for the number, say so early.



  





*Projects* 



* Own creative quality from concept through production to delivery on site.
* Build, brief and manage freelance content teams from our roster: 2D, 3D, real\-time, interactive, sound.
* Plan the content production: schedule it, resource it, track it, keep it on budget with the help of our internal team.
* Review and sign off content before it goes to the client or hits the media server.
* Present work to clients and collaborators with clarity and confidence.



  





*Studio* 



* Uphold creative standards across everything that leaves the studio.
* Motivate and guide creative teams across disciplines, from concept to delivery.
* Feed into internal R\&D and help shape the future creative direction of rapt.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 



* Proven experience making work for big spaces and big crowds, arena screens, building facades, one\-off sites, not just standard agency\-format content.
* A hands\-on tools background. You've come up through making, whether design, 3D, motion or real\-time, and grown into creative direction. You know roughly how a thing gets built and can navigate a project through it. Time spent agency side and a track record of winning pitches are both a plus.
* Strong creative strategy skills and an ability to frame ideas clearly for clients.
* Producer's instincts. You've scoped and costed content production before and know what a team of artists actually takes, in people, days and money.
* A clear eye for design, narrative and spatial storytelling.
* You can illustrate your own ideas. Sketch, storyboard, style frame, mock up. When you show an idea, people see it.
* Working knowledge of 2D, 3D, real\-time (Unreal, Notch, TouchDesigner) and Gen AI workflows.
* Experience working across immersive, spatial, digital or experiential formats.
* Experience building and managing freelance teams.
* Comfort collaborating with technical and production teams across disciplines.
* Highly organised. Able to lead multiple pitches and projects at once through ambiguity and deadlines without the quality slipping.
* Strong communication skills and confidence presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Live work sometimes means evenings and weekends on site.



  





**Perks** 



* 22 days holiday (plus public holidays), increasing with tenure

* CV
* Portfolio

This role partners closely with Apple University faculty, producers, writers, engineers, and others \- as well as partners throughout the company \- to conceive and deliver world\-class creative and to advance the purpose, culture, and impact of the whole organization.","responsibilities":"Brand and Design System: Maintain and evolve the visual and narrative identity for Apple University’s diverse range of formats, including live courses, interactive experiences, videos, podcasts, web content, print collateral, and digital tools  

  

Establish creative standards, a design system, engineering specs, and/or templates that ensure visual and typographic consistency, conceptual clarity, and an unmistakably Apple look and feel across an expanding catalog of AU offerings

Experiment with novel learning formats and interactive experiences, exploring emerging media and new platforms to continually expand AU’s reach, engagement, and impact

5\+ years of experience in a design or creative leadership role  

  

Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills  

  

Natural collaborator and mentor who thrives in a group environment and knows how to bring out the best in their own team and close partners  

  

Comfortable navigating ambiguity and aligning diverse experts toward a shared goal  

  

Experience with and passion for designing content that helps people learn, think differently, or change their behavior

Active curiosity about and practical experience with integrating generative AI tools into the creative process  

  

BA or BFA in Graphic Design or other related design discipline, or equivalent professional experience

15\+ years of experience in brand identity, communication design, or editorial art direction, with a multidisciplinary background spanning print, digital, motion, and/or experiential environments  

  

An exceptional portfolio demonstrating advanced expertise in creative presentation design, web design, UI/UX design, or other visual communication materials that showcases an aesthetic aligned with Apple’s design philosophy

 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.

 Experience Strategy:

* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.

* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.

title: Creative Director
description:
As a
 **Creative Director,** 
 you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human\-led.
 



  





 Designity is a premium, AI\-enabled and human\-led Creative\-as\-a\-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director\-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI\-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.
 



  





 They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* **Set the creative vision** 
 \- Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Turn business goals into creative opportunities** 
 \- Find the human and strategic insight behind the brief. Translate it into focused, emotionally resonant concepts that support the client’s objectives.
* **Guide the right creative team** 
 \- Help shape and lead multidisciplinary teams based on the needs of the client, brand, and assignment.
* **Conduct Quality Control \& Protect the standard** 
 \- Review concepts and execution for strategic relevance, originality, craft, brand alignment, and production quality.
* **Lead client conversations** 
 \- Present and defend creative ideas with confidence. Explain the reasoning behind recommendations and guide stakeholders through productive feedback cycles.
* **Develop creative talent** 
 \- Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.
* **Use AI with intention** 
 \- Leverage AI tools to strengthen research, ideation, exploration, and workflow efficiency. Retain human ownership of strategy, accuracy, taste, sensitive decisions, and final approval.
* **Build a strong creative environment** 
 \- Encourage originality, curiosity, respectful challenge, accountability, and collaboration.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 3 years in creative leadership roles
* A portfolio demonstrating strong work across branding, visual communication, digital experiences, motion, or integrated campaigns, with clear examples of how you have leveraged AI in your creative process and outcomes
* Great attention to detail to catch any branding inconsistencies

* The ability to translate complex business challenges into clear creative strategies and compelling concepts

* The adaptability, judgment, and reliability and strong internet connection needed to work effectively in a remote environment
* Practical experience using AI tools to strengthen creativity or efficiency without compromising quality or human accountability

 Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.
 



  





 At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.,
 



  





**What this role offers** 



* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W\-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast\-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.



  





**We believe great teams are built on shared values** 



* **Choose Positivity** 
 and lift those around you.
* **Say It Straight** 
 with honesty and respect.
* **Raise the Bar** 
 by never settling for average.
* **Take Ownership** 
 of your work and your impact.
* **Move with Purpose** 
 and make every action count.



  





**Success in this role means** 



* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.
* Balancing creativity with reliability, organization, and follow\-through.
* Embracing AI as a tool to enhance creativity and efficiency.



  





**Disclaimer:** 




 Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.
 



  





 Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.
 



  





 At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the AI\-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 38,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand\-distinctive, entertainment\-first work.** 
 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.** 
 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.** 
 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.


**How We'll Measure Success**
 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-forward environment.


*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
 Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 $157,505—$218,000 USD
   

  

**The Engine Edge: Perks \& Compensation**
 We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
   

  

* **Compensation:** 
 Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:** 
 Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:** 
 Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid\-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.


*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: Performance Creative Director
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** 
 is looking for a
 **Performance Creative Strategist** 
 to join our team! As our creative strategist, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a heavy focus on Meta VSLs, UGC ads, and high\-converting direct response ads \- short and long form \- that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3\+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in performance creative, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space — $22M\+ in revenue and targeting $45\-50M in 2026\. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
   

  

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**
 Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less \- and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning \- every problem is an opportunity to grow.
   

  

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9\-5 job, this isn't it.**
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands\-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.
   

  

**Key Objectives:**
* Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis
* Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives
* Script Direct response creatives
* Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives
* Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas
* Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
* Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
* Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

**Requirements**

* Fluent in English
* Direct Response Expertise: 3\+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must

* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders
* Proven VSL copywriting experience on DR / performance brands
* Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run
* AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production — not one you tried once
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased

**Examples of What You'll Be Doing:**
* Develop VSL briefings end\-to\-end: angle, hook, script, structure
* Design AI\-driven concepts and hooks for paid video
* Partner with editors and performance marketers on testing

**How Our Hiring Works \& How We Operate:**
 We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates in our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has three stages:
   

  

* Application Review \+ Screening \- we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit
* Technical Interview \+ Creative Brief \- a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work
* Culture Fit Interview \- a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us


 KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.

 USD $3,000 \- $6,000 per month base (based on experience and expertise) \+ percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
   

  

**We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta only.**

title: Art Director
description:
**ABOUT GMR MARKETING**

**We are** ***the*** **Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity**


**NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL.** ***EXPERIENCE.***



The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.


**NOT JUST TELLING.** ***MAKING.***



The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they'll never forget.


**NOT JUST CONSUMERS.** ***HUMANS.***



It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

  



You see ideas visually. You understand that great art direction is about more than making something look good. It's about creating a distinct point of view, building an aesthetic language, and knowing how every image, composition, detail, and decision works together to tell a story. You can take a concept from an early sketch or instinct and turn it into a visual world that people can see, feel, and connect with.



You're not just executing a creative direction. You're a creative partner who helps shape the idea from the start. You know when to push a concept further, when to challenge what is expected, and how to translate an idea across 2D, 3D, physical, and digital spaces. You can art direct a shoot, build a presentation that brings a concept to life, and give a team the clarity and confidence to see the vision.



Your visual thinking helps shape more than individual pieces. It helps shape entire campaigns. You'll work alongside Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists, bringing your perspective to the table and helping establish the aesthetic direction from the beginning. You'll also mentor emerging talent, sharing your perspective and helping others develop their own visual instincts. You're curious enough to explore what's next, confident enough to lead the vision, and thoughtful enough to know that great art direction lives in both the big idea and every detail that brings it to life.


***A portfolio or work samples are required to be considered for the role.***



**REQUIRED SKILLS**


* **Set the visual standard.** You'll shape the aesthetic direction for major projects, establishing the visual language, mood, and point of view that everything else builds from. You know how to take a brief and turn it into a visual world that feels distinctive, considered, and ownable across campaigns and brand touch points.
* **See the whole picture.** You move naturally between 2D, 3D, experiential, digital, and physical spaces, finding the right visual expression for an idea. You understand how individual images, compositions, materials, and details come together to create a larger brand experience.
* **Make ideas visible.** You're an exceptional visual thinker who can sketch, collage, build mood boards, and use AI imagery to explore ideas quickly. You know how to develop those early explorations into polished presentation materials and visual systems that make a concept clear, compelling, and easy to believe in.
* **Bring the vision to life.** You have experience art directing photoshoots and video production at a high level, from pre\-production through final delivery. You understand how to make thoughtful decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, location, and production while keeping the larger creative vision intact.
* **Shape the work, not just the execution.** You'll partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists. Sometimes you'll translate an existing vision. Other times, you'll help define it. You bring a strong point of view, ask the right questions, and know when pushing an idea further will make the work better.
* **Make good ideas better.** You'll develop visual systems that give teams a clear creative foundation, from palettes and compositions to imagery and aesthetic principles. You know how to create consistency without sacrificing personality, and you're comfortable working from the big picture down to the smallest detail.
* **Lead \& inspire.** Set the bar for excellence and create a collaborative environment where creativity thrives. You inspire, motivate, and challenge your team to consistently deliver exceptional work, while providing clear, direct, real\-time feedback that helps people grow not just improve the work in front of them.
* **Present with clarity and conviction.** You can lead a client through a creative idea, explain why the visual choices matter, and make a compelling case for the work. You bring both strategic thinking and artistic confidence to the room.
* **Bring the craft and experience.** You have professional art direction experience in an agency, production, or integrated creative environment, expert level sketching and rapid visualization skills, and mastery of Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Acrobat. You're curious about emerging tools and technologies and know how to use them to make the work more ambitious, not simply faster.
* **Bring a point of view.** Your portfolio shows aesthetic authority, diverse project experience, exceptional craft, and work produced at scale. More than anything, it shows that you can set a standard, lead a visual vision, and create work that people remember.


*The annual range for this role varies between $80,000\- $95,000 and may vary depending on the candidate's experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.*

**IMPACT \& INCLUSION**



Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.



Our guiding principles can be found here.



To view our compliance policies, please go to the main menu on our site GMR Marketing: Experience Marketing Agency.

title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**Location:** 
 New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising \& filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution \& delivery of our brand and products each \& every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, \& inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the
 **Design Director** 
 on the AlphaSense Brand \& Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull\-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader\-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
   

  

 This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest\-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* A Proven Creative Leader: 10\+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high\-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader\-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands\-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas\-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams \& Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross\-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high\-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex \& Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.


**What You’ll Do**
* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably\-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea\-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull\-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest\-stakes brand investments.
* Hands\-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build \& Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product \& Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface\-level aesthetics.


 For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
   

  

 You may also be offered a performance\-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
   

  

 Base Compensation Range
   

  

 $160,000—$200,000 USD
   

  

 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
   

  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.
