title: Podcast Producer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an organized, creative and hands\-on **Podcast** **Producer** to lead the end\-to\-end production and delivery of Alea’s two podcasts.


The Podcast Producer will be responsible for the complete operational process, from initial planning and pre\-production through recording, post\-production, approval and final publication. The role will ensure that every episode is produced on time, meets Alea’s quality standards and supports the company’s communications and brand objectives.


Working closely with the **Head of PR \& Communications**, the **Podcast** **Producer** will help define the strategy, positioning, editorial direction and distribution approach for both podcasts. This person will then translate that strategy into a structured production plan and manage its day\-to\-day execution.


This role is ideal for someone who combines editorial judgement, project management and technical production skills and who is comfortable coordinating guests, managing recordings, reviewing edits and overseeing publication across multiple platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\.** **Podcast** **Strategy and Editorial Planning**

* Define the strategy, positioning, objectives and target audience for both podcasts in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Contribute ideas for themes, episode topics, formats, guests and editorial series.
* Develop and manage an editorial calendar and release schedule for both podcasts.
* Ensure podcast topics and guests are aligned with Alea’s brand positioning, communications priorities and business objectives.
* Research relevant industry topics, trends and conversations to identify new editorial opportunities.
* Prepare episode concepts and proposals for review and approval by the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Regularly review the performance and direction of both podcasts and recommend strategic improvements.

### **2\. Pre\-production**

* Manage the complete pre\-production process for every episode.
* Research topics, guests and relevant background information.
* Identify and coordinate potential guests in collaboration with the Head of PR \& Communications and other stakeholders.
* Manage guest invitations, confirmations, calendars and all pre\-recording communications.
* Prepare episode briefs, scripts, interview structures, talking points and run\-of\-show documents.
* Organize recording schedules, locations and required resources.
* Coordinate studios, external production partners or technical suppliers when needed.
* Confirm that recording equipment, software, lighting, sound and other technical requirements are ready before each session.
* Brief hosts, guests and relevant stakeholders before recording.
* Ensure all necessary permissions, consent forms and content approvals are obtained.

### **3\. Recording and Live Production**

* Lead and coordinate each recording session, ensuring the process runs smoothly from start to finish.
* Set up or supervise cameras, microphones, lighting and recording software.
* Perform technical checks before every recording.
* Direct hosts and guests during the session when required.
* Monitor audio and video quality throughout the recording.
* Follow the agreed episode structure while allowing space for natural and engaging conversations.
* Identify strong moments, quotes and potential promotional clips during the recording.
* Resolve operational or technical issues quickly and efficiently.
* Ensure all recorded material is correctly saved, backed up and organized after each session.

### **4\. Post\-production and Quality Control**

* Manage the full post\-production process for every episode.
* Edit or coordinate the editing of audio and video content.
* Review all edits and provide clear feedback to internal or external editors.
* Ensure the final episode has strong pacing, narrative flow and consistent audio and video quality.
* Coordinate the addition of intros, outros, music, graphics, subtitles and other branded elements.
* Identify and prepare the strongest moments for trailers, teasers and promotional clips.
* Ensure every episode follows Alea’s brand guidelines and editorial standards.
* Manage the internal review and approval process with the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Complete a final quality check before publication, including audio, video, titles, descriptions, links, subtitles and visual assets.
* Maintain an organized archive of raw recordings, project files, final episodes and supporting materials.

### **5\. Publication and Distribution**

* Manage the publication of each episode across the relevant podcast and video platforms.
* Upload and publish episodes on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, Audible, YouTube and any other selected distribution channels.
* Prepare accurate and engaging episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps and supporting copy.
* Coordinate thumbnails, cover images and other visual assets with the Design team.
* Ensure episodes are correctly categorized, tagged and optimized for discoverability.
* Coordinate publication dates and promotional activity with the Head of PR \& Communications and Social Media \& Content Manager.
* Verify that every episode is published correctly and is accessible across all relevant platforms.
* Update or correct published content when necessary.
* Ensure podcast information and episodes are properly featured on alea.com when relevant.

### **6\. Promotional Content Coordination**

* Identify the strongest quotes, insights and moments from each episode for promotional use.
* Create or coordinate trailers, teasers, audiograms and short\-form video clips.
* Provide the Social Media \& Content Manager with the materials, context and key messages needed to promote each episode.
* Collaborate on the preparation of an episode\-specific promotional plan.
* Ensure all promotional assets are delivered before the agreed publication date.
* Coordinate with the Design team on thumbnails, templates, graphics and other branded materials.
* Support the repurposing of podcast episodes into articles, social media posts and other communication formats.

### **7\. Production and Stakeholder Management**

* Own and maintain the production workflow for both podcasts.
* Coordinate hosts, guests, internal teams, studios and external suppliers.
* Create clear timelines and ensure all milestones and publication deadlines are met.
* Keep the Head of PR \& Communications informed about progress, risks, delays and required decisions.
* Manage feedback and approvals efficiently to avoid production bottlenecks.
* Maintain production documentation, episode trackers, guest information and content archives.
* Monitor external production costs and resources when applicable.
* Identify opportunities to make the production process more efficient, scalable and consistent.

### **8\. Performance Analysis and Optimization**

* Track podcast performance across the relevant distribution and video platforms.
* Monitor metrics such as downloads, plays, views, watch time, audience retention, completion rate and subscriber growth.
* Analyse performance by podcast, episode, topic, guest and content format.
* Prepare regular performance reports with key findings and actionable recommendations.
* Report results and insights to the Head of PR \& Communications.
* Use audience and performance data to improve topics, formats, episode duration, production and distribution.
* Monitor podcast trends, competitors and industry benchmarks to identify opportunities for growth.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least **2–3 years of experience** in podcast, audio, video, broadcast or digital content production.
* Demonstrable experience managing the complete podcast production process, from pre\-production to publication.
* Experience recording and editing professional audio and video content.
* Hands\-on knowledge of microphones, cameras, lighting, recording software and editing tools.
* Experience with podcast hosting and distribution platforms, as well as YouTube Studio.
* Strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills.
* Ability to prepare briefs, scripts, interview structures and production documents.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple episodes, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Confident working with senior leadership, hosts, guests and external suppliers.
* Proactive, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of the full production process.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
* Spanish proficiency is considered an advantage.
* Previous experience in B2B, technology, media or iGaming is desirable.

**What We Offer**
=================

* A competitive salary package based on your experience.
* An impressive benefits package, focused on our culture of integral health that includes medical insurance, gym with personal trainer, sauna and hyperbaric chamber, and fresh fruit every day.
* Tax\-advantageous wage benefit: Meal card, transport package and other measures such as childcare allowance.
* Discount on Veg it (vegan meals) to order your lunch at the office.
* Flexible start and finish times.
* Reduced working hours in August.
* 23 holidays plus 3 extra days at disposal
* Hybrid Work Model.
* English classes
* Parking benefit for those who live outside of Barcelona.
* And what we are very proud of, you will join a young, motivated and powerful team with a great team culture. As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.

* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
**About the Firm**
------------------


We are the \#1 global consulting firm specialized in Sourcing \& Procurement. Our practice partners with CPOs, CFOs, COOs and CSCOs at the world's leading organizations to transform procurement functions into insight\-driven engines for growth, efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. Through our AI\-driven platform SynOps, proprietary market intelligence, and deep category expertise, we deliver end\-to\-end value across direct, indirect, and capex spend at scale. Our two flagship offerings — Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention — combine strategic advisory, managed services, and cutting\-edge agentic AI to generate measurable ROI for our clients.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Sourcing \& Procurement practice. This is a senior client\-facing role that combines deep functional procurement expertise with a strong business development mindset. The successful candidate will lead complex client engagements across Spend Optimization and Procurement Reinvention, develop relationships at C\-level, and actively contribute to the growth of the practice — ideally bringing an existing network in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas).


  

**What You Will Do**


Client Delivery \& Functional Leadership

* Lead end\-to\-end procurement transformation engagements, covering spend analysis, sourcing strategy, category management, supplier performance, and operating model design.
* Deploy Spend Optimization solutions (SG\&A and COGS) and Procurement Reinvention programs, including AI\-first operating model design, process redesign, and ecosystem integration (SAP/Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis).
* Oversee the design and implementation of Supplier 360 and procurement analytics dashboards to enable client visibility and insight\-driven decision\-making.
* Drive value realization through outcome\-based commercial models, with a track record of delivering measurable results (cost savings, supplier reduction, compliance improvement).

 **Business Development \& Client Relationships**

* Build and nurture C\-level relationships (CPO, CFO, COO, CSCO) at existing and target accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and thought partner.
* Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities, contributing to proposals, RFP responses, and executive presentations.
* Leverage an existing network — particularly in the Resources sector (Utilities, Oil \& Gas) — to generate pipeline and accelerate commercial conversations.
* Develop compelling points of view and credentials that differentiate the firm's offering in the market.

 **People \& Practice Development**

* Manage and mentor multi\-disciplinary project teams, fostering a high\-performance culture and developing junior talent.
* Contribute to internal capability building, including knowledge management, methodology development, and training programs.
* Collaborate with ecosystem partners (SAP, Coupa, iValua, and others) and cross\-functional teams to design integrated solutions.

 **What We Are Looking For**

 **Experience**

* 8–15 years of experience in procurement consulting, with a minimum of 4 years at a top\-tier management consulting or specialist procurement advisory firm.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale procurement transformation programs: spend optimization, category management, operating model redesign, and/or technology\-enabled procurement.
* Strong industry exposure in Resources (Utilities and/or Oil \& Gas) as a primary focus; additional experience in Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Industrials, or High Tech is a plus.
* Experience working with C\-level stakeholders and managing complex client relationships across multi\-country or global engagements.
* Demonstrable contribution to business development: pipeline generation, proposal leadership, or client network development.

 **Functional \& Technical Knowledge**

* Deep expertise across the procurement value chain: strategic sourcing, category management, supplier performance, contract management, and procure\-to\-pay.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled procurement tools and platforms (e.g., SynOps, SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, iCertis, Spend HQ) and the ability to articulate their ROI to clients.
* Understanding of agentic AI applications in procurement (benchmarking agents, negotiation assistance, intelligent buying channels) and the emerging landscape of AI\-first operating models.
* Knowledge of commercial models: outcome/value\-based deals, fixed fee, hybrid, and FTE\-based structures.
* Proficiency in procurement analytics and data\-driven decision\-making; experience with spend data analysis and dashboarding is a plus.

 **Leadership \& Commercial Attributes**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine ambition to grow a client portfolio and build lasting relationships — you think like an owner.
* Exceptional executive communication and storytelling skills; able to engage confidently in the boardroom and translate complexity into actionable insight.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical rigor, with the ability to frame ambiguous situations and drive decisions.
* Strong team leadership: proven ability to inspire, develop, and retain talent in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Fluency in English required; additional European languages (Spanish, German, French) are a strong asset.

The ideal candidate has built their career at the intersection of functional procurement excellence and strategic consulting — ideally with a background at a Big 4, top\-tier management consulting firm, or specialist procurement advisory (e.g., Efficio, Proxima, Accenture, McKinsey, BCG, Kearney). Equally important is a strong client network — particularly among CPOs, CFOs, and operations leaders in Utilities, Oil \& Gas, or adjacent sectors — and the demonstrated ambition and capability to convert that network into business.

* Market\-leading compensation package: competitive base salary \+ performance bonus \+ long\-term incentives.

Buscamos un Director Técnico de Integración para liderar y consolidar la práctica técnica en España. El candidato asumirá un rol estratégico, posicionándose como el nexo clave entre el negocio, las cuentas estratégicas y la entrega técnica.

Estrategia y Dirección Técnica
  
Definir la visión y los estándares tecnológicos de la práctica de integración en España.
  
**Diseñar e impulsar arquitecturas avanzadas:** orientadas a servicios (SOA), APIs, microservicios, Event\-Driven Architectures y mensajería en entornos híbridos y multi\-cloud.
  
Establecer e implementar modelos de gobierno de APIs, marcos de calidad (ej. CMMI), buenas prácticas y metodologías de diseño.

Colaborar directamente con el área comercial en la detección de oportunidades, elaboración de propuestas técnicas y económicas (RFP/RFI) y su defensa ante grandes clientes.
  
Liderar sesiones de consultoría de descubrimiento e interlocución con CIOs, CTOs y directores de IT para transformar necesidades de negocio en arquitecturas viables.
  
Diseñar Pruebas de Concepto (PoC) y arquitecturas de alto nivel (High\-Level Design) para demostrar el valor técnico de las soluciones.
  
Gestión de Proyectos, Clientes y Delivery
  
Supervisar la ejecución y entrega de múltiples proyectos de integración en paralelo, asegurando cumplimiento de tiempos, calidad y rentabilidad.
  
Mantener la relación ejecutiva con stakeholders clave y grandes cuentas, actuando como referente y punto de escalado.
  
Gestionar riesgos, desbloquear desviaciones críticas y coordinar la resolución de incidencias en entornos productivos.
  
  

Liderazgo y Desarrollo de Equipos
  
Dirigir, inspirar y mentorizar a un equipo multidisciplinar formado por Arquitectos de Integración, Devops y Developers.
  
Fomentar planes de desarrollo profesional, la capacitación técnica continua y la asignación eficiente de recursos a las distintas iniciativas.
  
3\. Requisitos del Perfil
  
Experiencia Requerida
  
Más de 15 años de trayectoria en el sector IT, con al menos 8 años en posiciones de dirección técnica, Delivery Manager, Technical Product Owner o Integration Lead en grandes consultoras o clientes corporativos.
  
Sólida experiencia demostrada en preventa tecnológica, licitaciones de gran envergadura y consultoría de valor.
  
Dominio en el diseño e implementación de middlewares de integración, orquestación de servicios y ecosistemas de APIs/microservicios.
  
Conocimientos Técnicos
  
**Middleware Integración:** Dominio de plataformas y herramientas como WSO2, MuleSoft, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus o equivalentes.
  
**Arquitectura Patrones:** Experiencia sólida en REST/SOAP, Microservicios, Event\-Driven Architecture, API Management, ETL/ELT e integración con sistemas legados.
  
**Bases de Datos Cloud:** Manejo de BBDD relacionales y NoSQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Couchbase) y plataformas cloud (Microsoft Azure, AWS o GCP).
  
**Metodologías Herramientas:** Marcos ágiles (Scrum, Kanban), gestión de roadmaps/backlogs y uso experto de Jira, Confluence y Azure DevOps.
  
Competencias Clave e Idiomas
  
Visión de negocio y alta capacidad de negociación técnica y funcional.
  
Capacidad de liderazgo, gestión de talento y trabajo bajo entornos de alta demanda.
  
**Idiomas:** Español nativo o muy fluido e Inglés C1 (imprescindible para entornos internacionales y documentación).

Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-260457 **Date posted** 09/22/2026
Senior Director, Global Commercial Data, AI \& Reporting Excellence


**Reports to:** VP, Global Insights \& Business Excellence (GIBEx), BBU


**Scope:** Global \| Commercial data, AI, digital platforms and performance reporting \| Approximately five direct reports plus matrix delivery teams


Role purpose


The Senior Director sets the enterprise direction for how BBU commercial data, AI and reporting capabilities are designed, governed and scaled. The role owns the business strategy and value of key commercial data products and decision platforms, ensuring that trusted data and responsible AI improve decision quality, speed, productivity and commercial outcomes.


This is a senior business and technology savvy leadership role. The role translates commercial priorities into an AI\-enabled data and digital roadmap; establishes clear product ownership, architecture principles, governance and reusable standards; and partners with Commercial IT, the Commercial Data Office, Finance, Enterprise AI teams, Operations, Insights, Analytics and Forecasting, global brand teams, regions and markets to deliver adoption and measurable value.


The portfolio includes pharmaceutical secondary market data and healthcare professional engagement data, together with the products, semantic definitions, interfaces, analytics and reporting platforms that make these assets usable. The role leads Data Product Owners and Platform Leads and is accountable for talent, delivery quality, investment choices, risk and value realisation.


Key responsibilities


* **Set strategy and investment priorities:** Define the multi\-year vision and roadmap for commercial data, AI, reporting and digital decision platforms, aligned to BBU and GIBEx priorities.
* **Own the business data architecture:** Establish target\-state principles for data domains, products, models, metadata, taxonomy, lineage, interoperability and access. Partner with Commercial IT on the technical architecture and prevent fragmented or duplicative solutions.
* **Lead AI\-enabled work redesign:** Identify where predictive, generative and agentic AI can improve decisions and workflows; prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk; and move successful solutions from experiment to governed, scalable products.
* **Ensure responsible AI:** Embed human accountability, validation, explainability, privacy, security, bias controls, monitoring and auditability across the AI lifecycle, in line with applicable policies and regulation.
* **Lead the data\-product portfolio:** Own product vision, outcomes, lifecycle, roadmaps and backlogs for commercial data products and platforms. Apply user discovery and product management to anticipate and solve priority business problems rather than produce outputs on request.
* **Create trusted data:** Establish clear ownership, quality standards, critical data definitions, controls and issue\-resolution routes for pharmaceutical secondary data and HCP engagement data.
* **Modernise reporting and decision support:** Simplify and standardise enterprise KPIs, reporting and executive performance views; increase reuse and self\-service; and retire low\-value or duplicative products.
* **Deliver measurable value:** Define and track adoption, decision impact, productivity, quality, risk and return on investment. Use evidence to stop, redesign or scale work.
* **Orchestrate enterprise delivery:** Align GIBEx, global brands, regions, markets, Commercial IT, the Commercial Data Office, Finance, AI teams and Operations around shared priorities, decision rights, standards and delivery plans.
* **Lead talent and partners:** Build a high\-performing, globally distributed team; develop AI, product, data and commercial capability; manage vendors, budgets, capacity and delivery risk; and create clear accountability across direct and matrix teams.
* **Advise senior leaders:** Translate complex data and technology choices into clear business options, trade\-offs, recommendations and risks for executive decisions.

Essential experience and skills


* Significant senior leadership experience in commercial data, analytics, AI, digital products or data platforms within pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another complex, regulated sector.
* Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise data and AI strategy, with evidence of moving products from concept through deployment, adoption, operation and measurable value.
* Strong working knowledge of modern data architecture, including domain\-based data products, cloud data platforms, integration patterns and APIs, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata, lineage, identity and access, and structured and unstructured data.
* Strong AI literacy across machine learning, generative AI and agentic workflows, including model and use\-case evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, retrieval approaches, monitoring and responsible AI controls. The role does not require hands\-on model coding but does require credible technical judgement.
* Expertise in data\-product and platform management: customer discovery, product vision, roadmaps, prioritisation, lifecycle ownership, service levels, adoption and value measurement.
* Deep understanding of data governance, quality, privacy, security, regulatory expectations and third\-party risk in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial data, including secondary sales and market data, claims or real\-world data, and HCP/customer engagement across digital and physical channels.
* Experience simplifying enterprise reporting, defining common KPIs and enabling governed self\-service analytics for senior decision\-makers.
* Proven ability to lead agile, cross\-functional and globally distributed teams and to manage vendors, budgets, dependencies and delivery risk.
* Executive\-level influence and communication: able to frame decisions, challenge assumptions, explain technical trade\-offs simply and secure alignment without direct authority.
* Strong commercial judgement, curiosity and learning agility, with a record of anticipating business needs and converting emerging technology into practical, scalable outcomes.
* Track record of coaching leaders and building scarce AI, data, digital and product capabilities.

Desirable experience


* Postgraduate qualification in data science, computer science, engineering, information systems, business or a related discipline.
* Experience with explainable AI, model risk management, MLOps or LLMOps, knowledge graphs, data mesh or fabric concepts, and AI\-ready data foundations.
* Experience redesigning operating models and workflows to embed AI at scale, including change, adoption and capability\-building.
* Country, regional or global experience in Insights, Analytics, Forecasting, Commercial Excellence or Digital.
* Ability to work globally, including international travel where required.

What success looks like


* Leaders use one trusted, decision\-ready view of commercial performance.
* Priority data and AI products have clear owners, standards, controls, adoption measures and realised business value.
* AI\-enabled workflows are scaled responsibly beyond pilots, with defined human accountability and evidence of improved quality, speed or productivity.
* Data duplication and manual reporting reduce as reusable products, common definitions and governed self\-service increase.
* The team has stronger AI, data architecture, digital product and commercial decision skills, with a sustainable succession pipeline.

title: Senior Retention Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only \- supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand\-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high\-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.


You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first\-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.


This is a copy\-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================


You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5\+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short\-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected\-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt\-in copy, welcome series, first\-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win\-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long\-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high\-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail\-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Lead Product Manager - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top\-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  

  

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built\-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass\-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  

  

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  

  

What powers the loop is talent density. 220\+ people from 30\+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  

  

At Homa, we are building the next billion\-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end\-to\-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.


Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in\-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end\-to\-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand\-in\-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross\-functional excellence.** You'll work hand\-in\-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end\-to\-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands\-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.


This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**  

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end\-to\-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product \& RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end\-to\-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre\-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps \& Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end\-to\-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership \& Ways of working**

* Strong **cross\-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands\-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast\-moving, high\-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**
At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best \- we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider \- we dive deep into the details.

  

**Benefits**  

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well\-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top\-tier talent from 35\+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off\-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.


Where We Hire
Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after\-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy \- all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).


We also have incredible team members across Europe \- from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC\+3\). If you're based there \- or planning to be \- we’d love to hear from you!

*Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.*

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We have a demand generation and expansion engine that's already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade\-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.



This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn't just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue.



You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you're the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade\-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth.



If you're a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data\-informed trade\-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing's job doesn't stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high\-performing growth team — this is your role.


**What you'll work on**


**Campaign strategy and design**


* Design the strategic framework for global multi\-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets
* Make commercial trade\-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you're expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what's actually driving outcomes
* Define campaign architectures across the full bow\-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time
* Brief the Content and Creative team on what's needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals


**Account\-based marketing strategy and execution**


* Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams
* Architect multi\-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities
* Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing
* Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy


**Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy**


* Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they're structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow\-tie
* Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross\-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics
* Make data\-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact
* Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle


**Regional strategy and localization**


* Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency
* Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion


**MarTech and data operations**


* Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems
* Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you're the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it
* Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust


**AI\-first campaign operations**


* Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning
* Bring an AI\-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making, not just execution
* Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day\-to\-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper
* Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used


**What we're looking for**


**Experience**

title: Técnico en Protección de datos e IA
description:

**¿Dónde estamos?**
-------------------



Las Tablas, Madrid.

**¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?**
--------------------------------


* Identificar y analizar los **riesgos de Seguridad y Privacidad** derivados de la legislación y normativa en materia de **Inteligencia Artificial**.

* Ajustar y actualizar dinámicamente la **gobernanza y el uso responsable de la IA**, así como los **controles y guardarraíles**, incluida su integración en herramientas, sistemas y plataformas.
* Evaluar y mitigar los **riesgos de la IA**, como sesgo, discriminación o explicabilidad, en algoritmos y modelos de IA, incluidas soluciones basadas en **LLM/GenAI y agentes autónomos**, a lo largo de todo su ciclo de vida.
* Promover la incorporación de **requisitos y controles de protección de datos y uso responsable de la IA** en los proyectos dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad.
* Evaluar **nuevas herramientas y capacidades** para su incorporación segura en la organización, determinando la postura de Seguridad y Privacidad ante los riesgos de IA y proponiendo medidas para su mitigación y priorización.
* Participar en proyectos que requieran la **aplicación de la IA a problemas de ciberseguridad**.
* Proponer, elaborar y revisar **normas y procedimientos** alineados con el Plan Director de Seguridad de Mapfre y con la legislación y normativa aplicable en materia de **Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial**.
* Participar en la implantación y evolución del **marco corporativo de IA Responsable**, alineado con el Reglamento Europeo de IA, GDPR y demás normativa aplicable.
* Realizar **evaluaciones de impacto y análisis de riesgo**s relacionados con soluciones de **IA, IA Generativa, plataformas agénticas y agentes autónomos**.
* Mantener **inventarios de casos de uso de IA** y colaborar en los procesos de **clasificación y supervisión de riesgos**.

* Trabajar en un **entorno global y multidisciplinar**, en contacto con las distintas geografías y áreas globales, para garantizar el **cumplimiento de la legislación y el marco regulatorio vigente**, conforme a los criterios y principios establecidos por la Dirección Corporativa de Seguridad.
* Proponer, implantar, mejorar y coordinar la **medición de indicadores de Protección de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial** con las distintas entidades y países de Mapfre.
**¿Qué necesitamos que sepas?**
-------------------------------


* Más de 4 años de experiencia en **Seguridad y Privacidad, frameworks, políticas, estándares, regulaciones y prácticas/disciplinas de riesgo tecnológico**.
* Más de 1 año de experiencia en **securización de arquitecturas con tecnologías de IA/ML y análisis de datos, gobernanza de datos e IA y gobernanza de tecnologías digitales emergentes**.
* Experiencia de al menos 1 año en **despliegues de proyectos IA en entornos cloud** (Azure, Amazon, Google).
* Conocimientos de **arquitecturas RAG, vector databases y sistemas agénticos**.
* Conocimientos sobre **configuración segura de plataformas unificadas de IA de AWS** (Bedrock) **Microsoft** (Azure OpenAI) y **Google** (Vertex AI).
* Se valorarán conocimientos, experiencia y certificaciones específicas en materia de **seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad** (CISM, CISSP, CCSP, CGEIT, CDPSE, CISA, CDPP.....)
* Conocimiento del entorno regulatorio relacionado con **Seguridad de la Información y Protección de Datos**, con capacidad para articular los principios de riesgo tecnológico y su gestión.
* Conocimientos en privacidad, relativo a **regulaciones de protección de datos** como GDPR.
* Conocimientos sobre el **Reglamento Europeo de IA**, **ISO 42001**, así como de otras regulaciones similares y buenas prácticas sobre el uso ético y responsable de la IA.
* Mantenerse al día de las últimas tendencias y avances tecnológicos en **IA / GenAI**.
* Experiencia en entornos empresariales de alta transaccionalidad, grande / complejo / organización internacional.
* Capacidades de trabajo en equipo, análisis/síntesis, planificación, orientación a resultados.

	+ Experiencia en colaboración en proyectos de plataforma tecnológicas de datos en arquitecturas cloud y metodología agile.

Si facilitas datos de terceras personas físicas distintas de ti, garantizas haber recabado y contar con el consentimiento previo de los mismos para la comunicación de sus datos y haberles informado.*

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort\-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

  

We are seeking a data\-driven and strategic **Senior User Acquisition Manager** to lead our Meta Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high\-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high\-value tech programs.

  

Requirements:
  

* 4\+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with hands\-on account work at real budgets in expensive markets in the last year or two.
* You have experience with expensive acquisition and long, multi\-step funnels — education, B2B, fintech, high\-ticket services — in the last two to three years, not earlier in your resume.
* Comfort with narrow audiences and thin data, where judgment fills the gap statistics won't, and a clear answer to what "enough delivery to decide" means.
* You know full\-funnel economics — CAC, contribution, cohorts, lead\-to\-call, call\-to\-sale — and read CRM and BI data alongside the ad account.
* Attribution, conversion events, pixels, and tracking QA are things you've owned, not things someone did for you.
* Strong craft: A/B testing offers and creatives, and briefs a production team can run with.
* AI is already how you work — Claude, call\-analysis tools, MCP connectors, choosing the right model, catching hallucinations.
* Full professional English level.

  

Brand:
  

TripleTen  

  

What you will do:
  

* Own the budget and paid strategy for the advanced programs line — roughly $200K/month today, scaling several times over by year\-end.
* Run Meta and Google (YouTube included) as core volume channels; open LinkedIn and run experiments in Reddit and Twitter.
* Own campaign and ad\-set architecture, plus the keep\-or\-kill calls: small batches, a data threshold before deciding, weekly cadence, an honest decision log.
* Brief the content producer and judge the output on metrics — you don't write scripts or build pages, creatives, or dashboards yourself.
* Own traffic quality rather than cost per lead: read sales call transcripts, see who actually shows up, and influence target\-audience share.
* Own attribution and conversion events — pixel and event setup, separate buying infrastructure, and reconciling the ad account against CRM and BI.
* Take each new program in the line into your channels with its own funnel and targets, adding sales rather than redistributing share.

  

What we can offer you:  

  

  

* Competitive compensation.
* Full\-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
* A close\-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
* All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

description:
**About the role**


We’re opening a delivery centre in Valencia. We are looking for an IT Manager to take operational ownership of the projects delivered there and to work as the direct deputy of the person running the site.


This is a launch role. The centre is being set up now, the team is being hired now, and the way it works has not been decided yet. Our site lead stays close to the clients and to business development. You take the operational side: framing the projects, running delivery, coordinating the teams, and helping build the structure as it grows. You will be introduced to clients as his counterpart, so the role is visible from day one. The scope is deliberately broad. It sits across project management, product ownership and business analysis, and the balance shifts from one project to the next. Generative AI is a real part of how they works.


The role does not require deep technical AI expertise, no agent development, no RAG, no MCP. It requires genuine curiosity and handson practice with AI tools, enough to hold a conversation with the engineering teams, spot the use cases worth pursuing, and bring them into the product roadmap.


Contract type Permanent or freelance to start, depending on what suits you.


If starting freelance, permanent contract required after a few months.


**Your responsibilities**


1\. **Project framing** Gather and formalize business requirements with stakeholders. Define scope, deliverables, milestones and success criteria. Write the requirement documents, functional specifications and technical specifications.


2\. **Product roadmap** Build and prioritize the product roadmap against business value and technical constraints. Arbitrate between business needs, technical reality and deadlines. Own the timeline and keep stakeholders informed.


3\. **Technical delivery** Write user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria. Prioritise and manage the backlog. Validate deliverables with both the technical and the business side. Coordinate across teams: development, design, data and external providers.


4\. **Budget Estimate** and track project effort and budget. Report regularly to management and sponsors. Optimize the balance between internal resources and external providers.


5\. **Risk and trade\-offs** Identify and manage project risks. Arbitrate between technical constraints and business objectives. Escalate blockers to the right level at the right time.


6\. **Governance** Run project committees and agile ceremonies, from sprint reviews through to planning sessions. Prepare progress reporting materials. Report to sponsors and management.


7\. **Stakeholder management** Act as the interface between the creative, technical, business and client sides. Adapt your communication to each audience and manage expectations. Hold the position of facilitator and arbitrator between parties.


8\. **Team coordination** Lead or coordinate technical teams, internal and external. Distribute workload, follow performance, keep the team engaged.


9\. **Quality and acceptance** Define acceptance criteria. Validate that deliverables meet them before they go to production.


10\. **Release and post\-launch** Coordinate deployments and production releases. Track performance indicators after launch.


11\. **Methodology** Work in Agile and Scrum, or in a V\-cycle where the context calls for it. Adapt the methodological framework to the maturity of the organisation you are working with.


12\. **Bringing AI into the work** Keep an active watch on generative AI tools and how they are actually being used. Identify where AI genuinely saves time in the product and project process, whether that is drafting specifications, generating summaries or automating repetitive work. Hold a credible conversation with the engineering teams on AI topics without needing to implement them yourself

**Your profile**


Education Bachelor's or Master's level in engineering, project management, computer science or equivalent.


Experience 5 to 15 years in IT project management, product ownership or business analysis, ideally a mix of the three.


**Languages**


* French is required. Several of our clients work in French and you’re working closely with the president and director.
* English is required. The engineering team works in English.
* Spanish is not required. Location
* Based in Valencia, or ready to relocate there. This role is not open to full remote. Proximity matters more here than in any other role in the team, because the job is built around working side by side with the site lead.
* Trips to Paris every month needed to visit the rest of the team there.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people \- helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.


What started in Poland is now an international, cloud\-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.


For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.


Working in a rapidly growing, ever\-changing scale\-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.


The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:

* Own end\-to\-end delivery across 4–5 cross\-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff\+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
* Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
* Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
* Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
* Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…* To think like a product owner, not a ticket\-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
* Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
* Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day\-to\-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
* To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high\-growth scale\-up or high\-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
* At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business\-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.


It will also help you to have…* Experience with two\-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
* Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
* B2B SaaS experience at scale.

  

**Benefits**  

* We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote\-first.
* Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote \- either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
* Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.

 **How AI helps us find great people**


Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role \- but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application \- it won't affect your chances in any way.

**Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:**


We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.

title: ML Engineer
description:
At Aristocrat, we are advancing gaming technology with modern, powerful solutions. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through play. We value collaboration, creativity, and a strong passion for excellence. These roles primarily support the Machine Learning area of our Product Madness business line — a tech company specialised in social casino mobile games. We are looking for an ML Engineer to join our MLOps team and strengthen its modeling core. You will own machine learning models end to end, from data and experimentation to production, and help us build the monitoring and experimentation culture that keeps them reliable and aligned with the business over time. You will make a real difference in our products and players' experiences.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, train, evaluate and retrain machine learning models — with emphasis on recommender systems — that support game features, player experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own the design of our model performance monitoring: define what to track (drift, data quality, degradation), thresholds, and what “the model is still healthy” means in business terms.
* Help establish a solid experimentation culture: model versioning and experiment tracking with tools such as MLflow or Weights \& Biases, so experiments are reproducible and model versions are easy to compare and promote.
* Help establish a model governance culture: define how models are promoted to production and lay the foundations of the communication contract between the MLOps team and Data Science.
* Create templates and cookiecutter scaffolding to standardise how Data Science structures, hands off, and communicates its models and experiments.
* Build robust training and feature\-engineering pipelines, and write clean, production\-ready Python and SQL.
* Explore and contribute to early\-stage projects involving LLMs, RAG and agentic AI where they bring value — as a complement to the role, not its core.
* Develop simple interfaces (e.g., Streamlit) to expose ML capabilities to non\-technical users when useful.
* Collaborate with teams across product, data, and engineering, and communicate results, limitations, and recommendations clearly across technical and business audiences.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4\+ years of experience applying machine learning to real\-world problems, from data to deployment.
* Proven experience with recommender systems (collaborative filtering, ranking, or similar) applied to real products.
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with ML libraries (scikit\-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, XGBoost or similar).
* Solid SQL expertise and experience working with large data warehouses.
* Hands\-on experience with experiment tracking and/or model registry tools (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or contributing to model monitoring / performance tracking in production.
* Comfort working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), Docker, and Airflow.
* A strong analytical foundation, with a background in a quantitative field (mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering) or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
* Hands\-on experience building applications with Generative AI (LLMs), including API integration.
* Interest or early experience in RAG systems — whether through prototypes, side projects, or professional work.
* Interest or familiarity with agentic AI concepts or frameworks (e.g., LangChain agents, CrewAI).
* Ability to build simple user interfaces (e.g., Streamlit) to expose ML models to wider teams.

**Why Aristocrat?**
-------------------


Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. Aristocrat has three operating business units, spanning regulated land\-based gaming (Aristocrat Gaming), social casino (Product Madness), and regulated online real\-money gaming (Aristocrat Interactive). Our team of over 7,300 employees worldwide is united by our company’s mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.


We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.


Travel Expectations \- Minimal travel required (up to 5%)

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Depending on the nature of your role, you may be required to register with the Nevada Gaming Control Board (NGCB) and/or other gaming jurisdictions in which we operate.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI\-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================


We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.  

  



Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.  

  



Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

This role is structured so you spend most of your time on The Bump, shaping core consumer product features, content tools, and user journeys across web, iOS, and Android. The remaining time will focus on Global Media Sales (GMS), creating sponsored features and scalable monetization solutions that serve all TKWW brands.



You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Editorial, and GMS stakeholders to understand customer needs, define opportunities, and shape product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of trusted content, digital product tools, and media monetization, this role requires a designer who can balance user value with business outcomes and move fluidly between strategy, systems thinking, and execution.

This role is Together@TKWW\-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You'll be expected to work in the office **two days a week** as part of our hybrid work model.
