Wherever our customers are in the world, we deliver them possibilities to work smarter and to operate more effectively, more safely, more sustainably \- without the limitations of technology.


With our possibility platform, we enable a comprehensive suite of end\-to\-end managed solutions (Connectivity, Network, Cyber Security, Cloud \& IT, IoT \& Apps), supported by professional services, unmatched global operations and delivery capabilities and local support teams.


As a global company with a local focus, we help make tomorrow’s possibilities today’s realities.

At OmniAccess, our vision is bold and clear: to deliver possibilities anywhere, empower innovation everywhere, and shape the future of maritime digital solutions.

 **Role Purpose:**


Marlink Group is seeking a dynamic Product Architect: Network \& Platform to shape and deliver the Network and Platform domains of the Possibility Portfolio. The scope spans Marlink's Edge infrastructure (CPE) and orchestration framework, and the network services that run on it — SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, bandwidth optimisation, QoS/QoE, and Network Access — across maritime and enterprise environments.


This is a hybrid role between product management and engineering. It is the bridge between business expectations and technical feasibility, and it works in both directions: shaping the products in the category into clear, sellable propositions, and driving their technical execution — requirements, coordination of teams, and proofs of concept.


The role is customer\-centric at its core. It starts from what customers need and how they buy and use our services, keeps that perspective present in every architecture and roadmap decision, and stays close to BUs and customers to make sure what we build is what the market values.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Commercial Productization

* Shape the products in the Network \& Platform category into clearly defined, sellable propositions — scope, tiers, packaging, and differentiation.
* Work with Pricing, Commercial and BU teams to turn cost and capability drivers into viable pricing and margin structures.
* Provide the technical substance behind go\-to\-market materials — value propositions, capability descriptions, and positioning.

2\. Requirements \& Feasibility

* Turn product requirements into precise technical specifications — the quality gate between product intent and engineering execution.
* Validate feasibility of roadmap commitments with Group Engineering before sign\-off.
* Translate engineering constraints and trade\-offs into product implications for the Head of Product and governance forums.

  

3\. Reference Architecture

* Own and maintain the Network \& Platform reference architecture — CPE, orchestration and service onboarding; SD\-WAN, LAN/Wi\-Fi, WAN optimisation, QoS/QoE and Network Access — co\-defined with Group Engineering.
* Define the integration requirements that let Connectivity, Cloud \& IT, Cyber and IoT services deploy consistently through the platform.
* Maintain architecture documentation, design standards and capability catalogues as shared Group standards.

  

4\. Technical Execution \& Team Coordination

* Drive product initiatives from requirement to release, coordinating across Group Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity and BU technical teams.
* Sequence dependencies between network and platform workstreams; surface conflicts and trade\-offs early.
* Act as the technical reference point during implementation, resolving ambiguity and arbitrating design decisions against product intent.
* Track delivery against roadmap commitments and report status and risks into governance.

  

5\. Governance \& BU Engagement

* Set architecture standards and ensure BU implementations conform to Possibility Portfolio guardrails.
* Engage BU product and technical teams regularly to capture local and customer requirements and feed them into the global roadmap.

  

6\. Innovation \& Proof of Concept

* Track emerging technologies — edge computing, virtualisation, AI\-driven operations and SD\-WAN, SASE, intent\-based networking — and market and customer trends relevant to the portfolio.
* Run proof\-of\-concept initiatives with Engineering to validate new capabilities, technically and commercially, before roadmap commitment.
* Define what each PoC must prove and convert the outcome into a clear recommendation: proceed, adapt, or stop.

* Products in the category are clearly defined, commercially coherent and ready to sell.
* Roadmap commitments are consistently feasibility\-validated before sign\-off.
* Engineering receives unambiguous, well\-structured requirements.
* Initiatives move from requirement to release with dependencies managed and without avoidable rework.
* The reference architecture is the recognised standard across Group Engineering and BU teams, with reduced variance across Business Units.
* New capabilities are validated through structured PoCs before commitment.

-----------------

**The Hybrid Profile**

* Track record at the boundary of product and engineering — a PM with deep architecture exposure, a Solutions Architect who moved into product, or a Network/Technical Lead with commercial instincts.
* Able to write a product requirement, review a design, and defend a commercial construct with equal rigour.
* Customer\-oriented: understands customer needs and translates them into product and architecture decisions.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
  

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.
  

  

**Your hiring experience matters**
  

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.
  

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

* Account overview and day\-to\-day navigation
* Transaction history, search, and categorization
* Payments (transfers, scheduled payments, SEPA, instant)
* Card management (virtual, physical, settings, limits, freeze)
* Cross\-market feature consistency

**Your role as a Product Designer**

You'll own end\-to\-end design for the core banking experience across mobile and web, designing surfaces that millions of entrepreneurs rely on daily. Your mission is to make complex financial interactions feel effortless, raising the bar on usability, consistency, and delight while shipping at pace.


**Your responsibilities will include:**


* Own banking experience design from discovery delivery measurable impact
* Design and iterate on high\-frequency surfaces that balance simplicity with functional depth
* Diagnose and improve daily\-use flows: account management, payments, card features, navigation
* Lead discovery with customers, synthesize usage data and research insights into decisions
* Contribute scalable components and interaction patterns to the design system
* Ensure cross\-platform consistency between mobile and web
* Partner with PM/EM on prioritization, trade\-offs, and roadmap shaping, co\-own engagement and retention metrics
* Participate in design rituals and raise quality while shipping pragmatically

 Job located in **Madrid,** with possibility of **two remote working days per week**.

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**



Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer\-to\-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.



What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross\-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.


**OUR CULTURE**



Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.


* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long\-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade\-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member \- no matter their level \- has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.


If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug\-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**



The **Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle \+ Journeys** owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in\-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win\-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.



This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.



Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity\-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged\-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.



You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.


**Responsibilities**


* Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026\), DE (October 2026\), and FR (November 2026\): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post\-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win\-back, replenishment, care instructions.
* Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end\-to\-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept\-to\-deployment time within 90 days.
* Partner with the Data team to run the triggered\-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
* Build channel\-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in\-app per flow per market.
* Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged\-in routing for non\-consenting users.
* Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN\-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
* Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity\-resolution accuracy.


**Qualifications**


**Required:**

* 6\+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
* Hands\-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
* Hands\-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
* Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
* SQL proficient. Can self\-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
* A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
* Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
* Detail\-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt\-in state, suppression rules).
* Strong cross\-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.


**Preferred:**


* Multi\-market lifecycle experience (UK \+ DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app\-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

**WHY QUINCE?**



Joining Quince means being part of a mission\-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY \& HIRING INTEGRITY**



Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.



Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis.



Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.


*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*



At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Hardware Industrialization Specialist
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Senior Coordinator, PASS Housing
description:
About CEA CAPA

  

At CEA CAPA, we believe studying and interning abroad is a transformative experience. By immersing themselves in new cultures, our students gain valuable skills and perspectives that shape their futures.

  

We’re proud to be a recognized sector leader, known for our delivery of impactful academic, professional and cultural experiences. This is achieved through our dedicated global team who provide comprehensive guidance, instruction, support and resources to maximize the benefit of our students’ time abroad.

  

A sense of belonging is central to CEA CAPA’s mission. We foster a work environment that values diversity and is free from bias. Our hiring practices are based on professional qualifications, skills and competence.

  

With a footprint that spans 53 cities in 20 countries across Europe, Latin America and Australia our 450 strong global workforce deliver exceptional cultural experiences abroad to over 7,000 students per annum.

  

Position Summary  

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The role combines hands\-on student support with responsibility for coordinating the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workflows and priorities, overseeing housing operations, and supporting the PASS Director with budget management and semester planning. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
The role supports students throughout their programs, from logistics to cultural integration, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience. It also involves administrative tasks such as managing program materials and handling student accommodation issues.  

Responsibilities  

* Serve as a senior point of contact for students, providing guidance, information, resources, and support throughout their program.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of the Housing team, organizing workloads, priorities, schedules, coverage, and operational deadlines.
* Support, guide, and coordinate team members, ensuring clear allocation of responsibilities, effective communication, and consistent service delivery.
* Oversee core student housing operations, including placements, arrivals, departures, room changes, maintenance, inspections, inventories, and accommodation\-related incidents.

* Participate in regular staff and planning meetings and provide operational updates, risks, budget information, and recommendations to the PASS Director.
* Support the onboarding, training, and day\-to\-day development of Housing team members and contribute to maintaining clear procedures and shared working standards.
* Be part of the emergency phone rotation and support the response to urgent student and housing situations in accordance with CEA CAPA procedures.
* Provide operational coverage and decision\-making support in the Housing area when required, particularly during peak periods, arrivals, departures, and staff absences.

  

Person Specification* Resilient and adaptable.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate people, competing priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated leadership and team coordination skills, with the ability to guide colleagues and promote accountability and collaboration.
* Strong budget management, financial tracking, forecasting, and cost\-control skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong relationship\-management and negotiation skills with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and contribute effectively to a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a practical, flexible, and creative approach to operational challenges.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and follow through on complex operational matters.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and other digital tools.
  

Qualifications and Experience* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish.
* Significant experience working with students, particularly international students.
* Demonstrated experience in student housing, accommodation operations, property coordination, or a closely related area.
* Experience coordinating or supervising team members, workflows, or operational projects.
* Experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure, and preparing forecasts or financial projections.
* Experience working with external vendors, landlords, service providers, and other operational partners.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse identities and backgrounds.
* Experience living or working abroad, with strong knowledge of the local culture, housing environment, business practices, and academic context.
* Knowledge of the U.S. higher education system is desirable.
* Authorization to work in the location of the role.
  

NB. This role profile is intended to provide an overview of the key responsibilities and qualifications for the position. It is not exhaustive, and the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks and duties as directed by leadership. Consequently, CEA CAPA reserves the right to modify this role profile at any time in accordance with evolving business needs and local legislation.

* Drive continuous improvement in packaging processes and technologies, identifying opportunities for **automation, standardization and sustainability** .

*

* **15\+ years of experience** in industrial Packaging Engineering, either within a manufacturing organization or packaging solutions provider.

* Strong technical knowledge of **industrial packaging materials, design, specifications and validation** , including returnable and expendable/one\-way packaging solutions.
* Proven experience developing and implementing **returnable packaging programs** .
* Demonstrated **people\-management experience** , including leading and developing technical teams across different locations and time zones.
* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .
* Strong experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and suppliers.
* Ability to combine **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** — we are looking for someone who can define the strategy but is also comfortable getting into the technical details when needed.
* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

title: Client Director - Private Client & Wealth structures
description:
**Client Director – Private Client \& Wealth structures**

**Solance** is building a tech\-enabled payments company. We are here for businesses that operate across multiple entities, jurisdictions and currencies, and for sectors that traditional banks generally overlook. Think family offices, internationally operating companies, corporate service providers and the clients they serve. We are going through the authorisation process with the Central Bank of Ireland, one of the most respected financial jurisdictions in Europe, and we are only getting started.

**Solance Private Clients** is one of our niches, built specifically for family offices and the parties that work closely with them. We begin with where we are strongest: payments and cards, giving clients a reliable financial partner for their day\-to\-day business. But that’s only the start. From there, we become the single point of contact for everything else a private client and their advisers need, from borrowing solutions and estate planning to investment advisory and wealth management. We do not provide those services ourselves. But we do solve them, drawing on a vast network of (private) banks, wealth managers, tax advisors and trusted partners who can facilitate almost any request a client brings. For every client need we will find the right party to accommodate such need.


**Your role, in plain terms**


This is a pure sales/BD seat. As Client Director for Solance you open doors, build trust, and turn relationships into a real pipeline. You will work the market you already know: the CSPs, the fiduciaries, the (multi) family offices, the wealth managers and the advisers who orbit private wealth. You bring them to Solance, and you own the relationship from there. Think of it as your own shop within Solance. You own the niche, you shape the brand of the Private Client business, and you run it with the freedom of a founder and with a tech\-enabled licensed EMI behind you. Nobody hands you a script or confines you to a certain territory. You determine where the business is and you go and build it.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You are about eight to ten years into your career, you have spent most of it in the world that revolves around private wealth: CSPs, international tax advisory, fiduciary firms, private banking, or any position where your days were spent across the table from private clients and their advisors.
* Ideally you have worked at more than one firm, so you understand how the PC industry really works, and you have a network that runs across that industry.
* People with a background in PC advisory and corporate services know two things you cannot teach overnight: a network, and the lingo.
* You already know a lot of CSPs, the introducers and the advisers.
* You understand what it takes to work with private banks and wealth managers, how and why corporate structures are actually created, what substance really means in practice, and how to talk to clients who expect to be taken seriously. That head\-start is exactly what Solance is built on.
* You add value to your clients.
* You are credible, discreet, and easy to trust in a room full of advisers and/or principals.
* You have energy, you get things done.
* You know where the business is, and you go and get it.

We need a builder, not a maintainer. Someone who runs, who is genuinely hungry, who gets a kick out of chasing a deal and closing it.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Eight to ten years’ experience in a Private Client environment (CSP, advisory, banking), ideally across more than one firm.
* A genuine specialisation in, or strong exposure to, private clients and wealth.
* An active network of CSPs, fiduciaries, introducers, advisers and bankers.
* Skilled in structuring, substance and how international private wealth is organised.
* A builder's mentality: hungry, self\-starting, eager to run your own shop.
* International, and preferably multilingual. (English is a must)

**What is in it for you**


You will work very close with the CEO of Solance, not three layers down. You get real ownership of your client book, room to grow a team as your sales justify it, and the freedom to build the Private Client business, and its brand, from the ground up as if it were your own company. This comes with a competitive package, bonuses tied to what you actually bring in, and the chance to become a recognised name in a market you already care about. It is a builder's seat above all.

**Where you come from**

* We already have a good network in Luxembourg, Switzerland and Malta, if that’s your world, we’d love to hear from you too. But we are mostly interested in someone who opens new ground: The Netherlands, Cyprus, Iberia, the Nordics, wherever your relationships run deepest.
* Languages and a genuinely international footprint are a real advantage.
* Where you are based does not matter to us. You will be on the road constantly, in front of clients and partners wherever the business is, so base yourself wherever suits you. What matters is your reach, your network and your appetite for travel. That said, we do want you in our Dublin office on a regular basis, to stay close to the team and to feed what you are hearing from clients back into the business.
* You will be our ears in the market, and the product gets better because of what you bring home.

**Let us talk**


If this reads like you, get in touch. And if it reads like someone you rate, send them our way, or send us the introduction.

title: Product Manager, Amazon Alexa
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon Devices \& Services, we imagine the future, and then create it. Join brilliant minds to build new categories of technology that become part of everyone's everyday life. Together, we create connected experiences that transform lives, communities, and the world with our work.  

  

The Amazon Alexa International team is looking for a Product Manager to own and shape the Alexa experience for customers in Spain. In this role, you will contribute to the product vision and roadmap for Alexa in the Spanish marketplace — identifying customer opportunities, setting priorities, and driving execution across a complex, cross\-functional landscape. You will work backwards from Spanish customers to determine what a truly delightful, locally relevant personal assistant experience looks like, and then make it happen.  

  

In this role, you will define ambiguous problems, shape goals from customer insight and data, and design solutions that scale. You will make high\-judgment calls with incomplete information, navigate technical trade\-offs alongside engineering partners, and balance near\-term delivery against long\-term architectural integrity. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of ambitious outcomes — and own the results.  

  

If you are passionate about AI, love building products that delight millions of customers, and want to shape the future of Alexa in Spain, we look forward to your application.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the product development of Alexa in Spain: define the what and why, not just the how, working backwards from Spanish customer needs and market dynamics
* Work in the product roadmap end\-to\-end: identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable customer experience improvements
* Navigate ambiguity; problems and approach may not be defined. Use expertise, customer insight, and data to determine the right goals and design long\-term solutions
* Be the Voice of the Customer: conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and market analysis to distinguish representative signal from anecdotal feedback across the Spanish customer base
* Drive data\-informed decisions: define success metrics, analyze data and customer behaviour, and identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for improvement
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with engineering, science, design, localization, marketing, legal, and operations teams: influence without authority to build alignment across teams with different priorities
* Own launches and post\-launch performance: drive awareness, adoption, and continuous optimization of the Alexa experience
* Contribute to organizational planning: participate in strategic planning, write narratives and drive product discussions with Senior Managers and Directors
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs: understand how technology choices influence customer outcomes, ask the right questions, and balance feature delivery with sustainability

  

* Please note, Amazon is an English\-speaking company day\-to\-day

  

About the team  

This role is part of the Alexa International organization, which develops and supports the Alexa experience across all international markets. You will operate within the European team, working closely with country teams across Europe while contributing to the Spanish marketplace roadmap. The team is passionate about building locally relevant, delightful experiences powered by AI technology.  

  

Location for this role is in Madrid.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience with product localization and building locally relevant customer experiences
* Experience applying GenAI tools (e.g., coding assistants, AI agents) to accelerate delivery and/or improve quality
* Native\-level (C2\) fluency in written and verbal Spanish including cultural fluency, including regional humour, tone, idiom, and social context

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with voice/AI products, conversational interfaces, or natural language technologies
* Speak, write, and read fluently in other EU languages
* Experience in process automation, and tool development using AI

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Hey there!
  

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet The Team**



At Fever's SEO team, we capture and influence demand when millions search for what to do next. We engineer visibility across the entire discovery ecosystem: traditional search engines, LLMs, local listings, third party integrations and beyond. Our diverse portfolio of ecosystems and operating companies gives us the scale and complexity to master every SEO specialization—from technical infrastructure and content architecture, to AI search optimization, local market dominance, and brand authority building. We operate globally, automating and optimizing processes to drive efficiency at scale.  

  

We combine data, technical excellence, and strategic thinking to drive organic growth revenue. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operational teams, we shape how users discover experiences across our global platforms.  

  

Join us to redefine how the world finds experiences, together.

At Fever, we're building something exceptional—combining strategy, creativity, and the power of advanced technology to redefine what's possible in organic search. By partnering with world\-class Product, Engineering, Data and Marketing teams, we leverage cutting\-edge tools and data\-driven insights to deliver exceptional performance and measurable impact across major search engines and dynamic digital ecosystems.



As an AI Search Innovation Lead, you will drive the evolution of our brand's authority in the next era of search, focusing entirely on impact over traditional acronyms. You will lead the testing and measurement of how LLMs construct answers, designing the analytical frameworks to track our visibility across major AI models and emerging platforms like MCPs. Collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and PR teams, you will optimize our architecture for seamless AI ingestion and execute strategies to actively shape and accelerate LLM perception.

description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep\-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3\.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.


We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.  



**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.  



Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.  



Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M\&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.


* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.
* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow\-up.
* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.
* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality\-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.
* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.


* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.
* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.
* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.
* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.
* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M\&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.


* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI\-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.
* **Run first\-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.
* **Organise the AI\-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.
* **Coordinate with Strategy and M\&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.
* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow\-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.


* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.
* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.
* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.
* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.
* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross\-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

description:
**Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware**

This role aligns to industry\-level titles such as Head of Product, Director of Product Management, Product Portfolio Director, or similar product leadership positions with responsibility for portfolio strategy, commercial performance, and team leadership.


**Role Overview**

The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. The portfolio spans print, blended and digital courseware, supplementary materials, teacher professional development, and partner\-created content.


This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. The role will decide where Pearson invests, grows, localises, simplifies and exits, with accountability for creating products that teachers choose, improve student learning outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue growth and strong returns.


A central part of the mandate is leading the evolution of a print\-heavy portfolio towards connected, digital and AI\-enabled learning experiences. Pearson intends to lead this transition while staying grounded in the needs and readiness of teachers and institutions.


The role owns the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and portfolio strategy through development, launch, performance management and retirement. It owns investment cases for approval by the ELL Leadership Team, recommends pricing and packaging, and drives initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.


The role leads a global team of approximately 15 colleagues through managers and works across Content, Learning Science, Engineering, Assessment, UX and AI. It is a member of the ELL Product Leadership Team and ELL Content Leadership Team, acting as the senior product owner for institutional courseware and aligning Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and Finance around a clear portfolio direction.

**Set the Portfolio Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy and roadmap for institutional courseware, based on customer needs, market opportunities, learning outcomes, and commercial performance.
* Manage portfolio investments, prioritisation, localisation, innovation, and product lifecycle decisions.
* Act as the senior product authority, providing strategic recommendations to the ELL Leadership Team.

**Understand Customers and Markets**

* Build deep understanding of learners, educators, institutions, ministries, and partners across priority markets.
* Use customer insight, market trends, learning evidence, and performance data to drive product and investment decisions.
* Support strategic customer and ministry engagements alongside Sales teams.

* Translate strategy into compelling value propositions, product roadmaps, and requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact learning solutions that balance customer value, learning effectiveness, quality, speed, and commercial outcomes.
* Validate opportunities through customer research, pilots, and data\-driven decision\-making.

* Identify and scale responsible AI opportunities that enhance learning, teaching, accessibility, and product efficiency.

* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, and investment recommendations for new and existing products.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to achieve customer, learning, revenue, profitability, and ROI objectives.

* Establish and monitor success metrics across learning outcomes, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, retention, revenue, and profitability.

* Global products that combine scale with effective localisation.

* Experience leading cross\-functional product development in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Experience building product teams and developing product leaders.
* Experience in education, publishing, courseware, EdTech or learning products is strongly preferred.
* Experience applying AI, data or emerging technology to products is preferred.

description:
TomTom is a global leader in navigation, mapping, and traffic information. Join our dynamic team and vibrant culture to contribute to shaping the future of location technology.  


We are looking for an Applied Scientist to shape how AI understands and uses TomTom's location data. You'll develop machine learning models and design the systems that let LLMs reason accurately over maps, traffic, points of interest and routing. You'll turn open\-ended product questions into well\-defined scientific problems, validate solutions with rigorous evaluation, and work with AI and software engineers to bring them to production.
### **What you'll do:**

* **LLM–data interfaces:** Research and design how LLMs access and reason over TomTom's data. This covers retrieval strategies for structured and geospatial data, tool and API designs that LLMs can use reliably, text\-to\-query approaches, and grounding techniques.
* **Data representation:** Develop representations that make location data usable by AI, such as embeddings for geospatial entities, knowledge graphs and structured context formats.
* **Evaluation science:** Define how we measure whether LLM\-powered systems are right. Build benchmarks, factuality and hallucination metrics, and evaluation datasets for location\-grounded tasks, and work with engineers to automate them.
* **Model research and development:** Design, train and fine\-tune ML and deep learning models, including LLMs, computer vision, time\-series and graph\-based methods, using large\-scale, multi\-modal data.
* **Problem framing:** Work with product managers and stakeholders to identify high\-impact opportunities and turn them into well\-defined scientific problems with clear success metrics.
* **Research to production:** Write production\-quality code and work with AI and software engineers to take solutions from prototype to production, balancing accuracy, latency, cost and scalability.
* **State of the art:** Keep up with the latest research in LLMs, retrieval and agentic systems, and adapt promising techniques to TomTom's problems.
* **Knowledge sharing:** Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and help build a strong scientific culture. External publications and patents are encouraged.
### **What you'll need:**

description:
**Cabinet D\-JP.A** is conducting a search for a client operating in the **stock images and digital visual\-content industry**. The client is developing a new business platform designed to respond to the structural transformation of the global visual\-content market and is now seeking a Chief Executive Officer to lead its next phase of development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and execute the company’s strategic roadmap in close collaboration with the consortium founders and shareholders.
* Translate the strategic vision into clear operational priorities and measurable objectives.
* Establish key milestones, performance indicators and management reporting.
* Identify new strategic opportunities and adapt priorities as the market evolves.
* Ensure the organisation remains focused on its core growth and value\-creation objectives.

**Commercial Development**

* Define and execute the company’s commercial and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Develop new revenue streams and identify scalable business opportunities.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, strategic accounts and commercial partners.
* Develop a scalable business model capable of supporting international growth.
* Establish the foundations for expansion into new markets.
* Build a strong, performance\-driven commercial culture across the organisation.

**Financial Management \& Fundraising**

* Take overall responsibility for financial performance, budgeting, forecasting and cash management.
* Establish robust financial reporting and management\-control processes.
* Prepare and regularly update the company’s business plan and financial projections.
* Lead fundraising initiatives in collaboration with founders and shareholders.
* Build credible relationships with investors, financial partners and other stakeholders.
* Prepare the company for future financing rounds and investor due diligence.
* Ensure capital is allocated efficiently and in line with strategic priorities.

**Technology \& Innovation**

* Work closely with technology leadership to define the product and technology roadmap.
* Translate commercial and strategic requirements into clear technology priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of developments in artificial intelligence, digital platforms and emerging technologies.
* Identify technologies capable of improving scalability, efficiency and customer experience.
* Ensure technology investments support the company’s long\-term competitive positioning.
* Encourage innovation while maintaining clear commercial and operational objectives.

**Building the Organisation**

* Build and lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary organisation.
* Recruit key executives, managers and specialist talent as the company develops.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Establish effective management processes and appropriate corporate governance.
* Develop a culture combining entrepreneurial agility with professional execution.
* Create an organisation capable of scaling internationally without unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop senior\-level relationships across the digital media, technology, creative and cultural ecosystems.
* Identify and negotiate strategic commercial and technology partnerships.
* Explore opportunities for distribution, content, licensing and international collaboration.
* Build relationships capable of accelerating market access and business development.
* Represent the company with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should have the ability to transform an ambitious strategic vision into a scalable international business :

* Significant experience as a **CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Founder, senior COO** or comparable executive leader.
* Ideally **7\+ years of senior management or leadership experience**.
* Demonstrated responsibility for business strategy, financial performance and operational execution.
* Experience developing and implementing business plans and growth strategies.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial reporting.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organisations through periods of growth.
* Demonstrated commercial and business\-development capabilities.
* Experience working with founders, shareholders, boards and/or investors.
* Exposure to fundraising, financing rounds or investor relations would be particularly valuable.
* Experience with digital platforms, technology\-enabled businesses or international expansion.
* Professional fluency in **French and English**; additional languages would be an advantage.

Relevant industry backgrounds may include **digital media, technology, AI, SaaS, marketplaces, creative industries, photography, digital commerce, licensing, fintech or platform businesses**.

Experience in the visual\-content or stock\-image industry would be valuable, but it is **not a prerequisite**.

**Location \& International Scope**

The position is based in Lisbon, Portugal, with an international scope. The CEO will work with shareholders, partners and stakeholders across different markets and should be comfortable with international travel when required.

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial conversation with the recruitment team at Cabinet D\-JP.A.
* Executive interviews with the consortium founding members.
* Strategic discussion around the business plan and CEO mandate.
* Final offer and appointment.

Candidates may be asked to provide a perspective on how they would approach the first 12–18 months of execution for the round A shareholders. The identity of the client will be progressively disclosed to candidates who have been qualified and selected to advance in the process. If this opportunity corresponds to your experience and ambitions, please submit your CV together with a short executive introduction to Cabinet D\-JP.A. All enquiries will be handled confidentially.

description:
At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you will be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers.

  

We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon. As the **Director, Field Reimbursement**, you will provide strategic leadership for supporting patient access and reimbursement strategy across our U.S. Pharmaceutical Glaucoma and Dry Eye portfolio. Leading a geographically dispersed team of Field Access Managers, you will shape and execute scalable **market access**, **patient access**, and **reimbursement strategies** that help optimize access to therapy and drive business success. This is a **remote U.S.\-based role** with approximately 50% domestic travel to support field engagement, customer interactions, cross\-functional collaboration, and key business initiatives.

  

As a key member of the leadership team, you will partner closely with Commercial, Brand, Medical Affairs, Sales Leadership, and Commercial Operations to translate evolving **payer policies**, **coverage dynamics**, and reimbursement trends into actionable strategies that improve patient access and support organizational priorities. You will provide strategic oversight of reimbursement programs, guide cross\-functional initiatives, and influence solutions across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and specialty pharmacy environments.

  

This opportunity is ideal for leaders with deep expertise in **Field Reimbursement**, **Market Access**, **Patient Access**, **Payer Strategy**, and **Reimbursement Leadership** who are passionate about driving meaningful change in healthcare. You will have the opportunity to shape national reimbursement and access strategies, lead a high\-performing field organization, and collaborate across complex healthcare and pharmaceutical ecosystems to deliver measurable impact. If you have a proven track record of leading national teams, driving strategic initiatives, and influencing access outcomes, this role offers the chance to advance patient access while helping define the future of reimbursement strategy within a global healthcare leader.

 **A typical day, looks like:**

 **Strategic Leadership \& Program Oversight**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight for Field Reimbursement programs across the U.S. Pharmaceutical Glaucoma and Dry Eye portfolio, supporting consistent execution of program KPIs and service\-level agreements.
* Develop and execute comprehensive national reimbursement and patient access strategies aligned with commercial objectives, with a focus on addressing potential reimbursement obstacles and improving access to medications.
* Participate as a key member of the Market Access senior leadership team and travel as needed for team development, client engagements, internal leadership meetings, training, and market access initiatives.

**People Leadership \& Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop six geographically dispersed Field Access Managers, partnering with training teams and vendors to strengthen field reimbursement capabilities and support organizational goals.
* Monitor territory effectiveness to optimize field productivity and recommend territory realignment opportunities to support business objectives and customer needs.

**Market Access Strategy \& Reimbursement Excellence**

* Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures for reimbursement support services, including benefits verification, prior authorizations, and appeals.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on payer requirements and reimbursement processes, translating complex coverage dynamics into clear, actionable guidance for internal stakeholders and field teams.
* Develop strategic responses to payer policy and formulary changes to support consistent patient access across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid insurance landscapes.

**Payer \& Healthcare Ecosystem Engagement**

* Monitor market trends, payer landscape changes, and coverage policies to inform reimbursement strategy and enhance patient access.
* Strengthen coordination among field reimbursement teams, hub services, specialty pharmacies, national accounts, and strategic payer contacts to improve connectivity and provider understanding of coverage requirements.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Business Alignment**

* Partner across Brand Management, Market Access, Sales Leadership, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and Business Unit leadership to align field execution with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

 **WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO ALCON:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school \+18 yrs; Assoc.\+14 yrs; M.S.\+7 yrs; PhD\+6 yrs)
* The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English
* 10 Years of Relevant Experience
* 6 Years of Demonstrated Leadership
* **Travel:** Up to 50%

 **Preferred**

* Experience leading national Field Reimbursement, Market Access, or Patient Access organizations supporting multiple products, therapeutic areas, or business units.
* Experience supporting branded pharmaceutical products within highly competitive therapeutic markets.
* Knowledge of specialty pharmacy operations, patient support programs, reimbursement assistance services, and healthcare access solutions.
* Experience collaborating with payer organizations, specialty pharmacies, reimbursement support vendors, healthcare providers, and national accounts.
* Demonstrated success developing scalable reimbursement and patient access strategies that improve patient outcomes and organizational performance.
* Experience utilizing market intelligence, access analytics, and payer landscape insights to inform strategic decisions.

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing
description:
**Our Global Structure**

  

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.


Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high\-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long\-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

  



We're looking for a Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing to join our team. This is a remote role based in Europe (preferred hubs: London, Berlin, Copenhagen, or Helsinki). In this role, you'll help us lead the Corporate Services Sourcing team for the Deliveroo and Wolt brands, driving strategic category management and delivering commercial value across a multi\-million\-pound indirect spend portfolio.

  



Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

  


### **What You'll Be Doing**



You'll be joining the Global Sourcing team within our Global Procurement organization, reporting into the Director, Head of Global Strategic Sourcing. You will lead a team of five (5\) managing a broad portfolio across EMEA (including Professional Services, Global Security, Facilities/Real Estate, BPO, HR/Benefits, and Contingent Workforce), while partnering with the DoorDash Corporate Services team to capture global enterprise synergies.

  



Here's what your day\-to\-day might look like:

  



Category Strategy \& Leadership


* **Lead and develop a high\-performing sourcing team** of five, setting clear goals, driving accountability, and building capability across the Corporate Services portfolio.
* **Build and execute multi\-year category strategies** that increase category maturity, optimise total cost of ownership (TCO), and unlock value beyond traditional cost savings.
* **Partner with DoorDash sourcing leads** to align global category strategies, leverage enterprise scale across brands, and capture cross\-regional synergies.

Execution \& Supplier Management


* **Own the end\-to\-end sourcing lifecycle** for high\-stakes corporate procurement, including data analysis, RFx creation, proposal evaluation, and complex contract negotiations (MSAs/SOWs).
* **Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point** for executive stakeholders across G\&A functions (Finance, Legal, HR, Security) and core business lines.
* **Establish best\-in\-class supplier ecosystems**, tracking performance, SLAs, and supplier risk while embedding ethical and sustainable sourcing (ESG) practices.
* **Contribute to procurement transformation initiatives**, championing new tooling, AI\-driven sourcing workflows, and continuous process improvements.

### **What You'll Need to Thrive**



Essential


* **Significant experience in Corporate Services Sourcing**, with a proven track record of developing and executing strategic category plans across indirect spend categories.
* **Demonstrated people management capability**, with experience leading, mentoring, and developing high\-performing sourcing professionals.
* **Strong commercial and negotiation acumen**, with proven ability to structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and utilise TCO modelling.
* **Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills**, capable of influencing senior leaders, managing matrixed business partners, and driving cross\-brand collaboration.
* **Deep risk management expertise**, including third\-party risk assessments, contract governance, and mitigation strategies within multi\-jurisdictional environments.

Nice to Have


* Experience working within the technology sector or high\-growth, fast\-paced marketplace environments.
* Proficiency with modern procurement and CLM platforms (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, Pivot) and enthusiasm for applying AI tools in day\-to\-day sourcing workflows.
* Experience operating across European markets and diverse regulatory/legal structures.

### **Why Join Us?**



At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.



We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  



**Make a visible impact every day**



Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

  



**Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment**



Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

  



**Build a career, not just a role**



Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

  



**Deliver together in an inclusive culture**



Collaborative, values\-driven teams that support how you work best.

  



We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  

  

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.



We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.



If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.



If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Associate Director, Algorithm and Artificial Intelligence Assurance
description:
### **Basic information**


Location
London
