### **Job description**


**Connect to your Industry**


Deloitte's Assurance practice provides a full range of high value assurance services to many of the world's leading businesses. Our purpose is to protect the public interest and build trust and confidence in business.


Our Assurance practice encompasses skills across regulation and finance with a deep analytics capability. We harness these to provide Assurance to those charged with governance, serving the public interest. Working in Assurance means you will have an opportunity to work alongside leading experts, as we help build and enhance trust between businesses and the public, by responding to emerging issues and protecting the public interest. Providing assurance to help businesses become more resilient, agile and better prepared for the future.


To be resilient, businesses must be ready to respond to current and future challenges and opportunities. They are increasingly being required to be more transparent with their reporting, to drive trust and confidence in the market, and protect the wider public interest.


Assurance builds, maintains and develops confidence. We provide independent assurance by assessing the risks and underlying processes, providing conclusions as to which risks are being managed and mitigated in line with the business’ appetite for risk. Deloitte’s assurance offerings help those charged with governance to understand their business and build trust amongst key stakeholders and regulators.


**Algorithm and AI Assurance**


Deloitte's Algorithm \& AI Assurance team is at the forefront of a rapidly evolving landscape. We are a multi\-disciplinary team of specialists with expertise in artificial intelligence, data science, regulatory compliance, and audit \& assurance. We work with organisations across industries to help them build trust and confidence in their algorithms and AI systems.


Our team plays a critical role in shaping the responsible development and use of these transformative technologies. We are passionate about helping our clients understand and manage the risks associated with algorithms and AI. We also provide independent Assurance to companies on their compliance with new Algorithm and AI related regulations.


**Connect to your career at Deloitte**


Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.


What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we **lead the way**, **serve with integrity**, **take care of each other**, **foster inclusion**, and **collaborate for measurable impact**. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.


**Connect to your opportunity**

We are looking for an Associate Director to join our Algorithm and AI Assurance team in London to lead and contribute to the delivery of high\-impact assurance projects across a range of clients and technologies.


As an emerging leader of the team, we will provide you with ongoing support to allow you to further


develop into a leading specialist in your discipline, gain experience of others, and play your part in


maintaining and building our esteemed position in the market.


You will be:


* Supporting the building, leading and nurturing of a team of 20 Algorithm and AI specialists.
* Leading and managing a team providing guidance and support across the Algorithm and AI Assurance focus areas described above.
* Providing assurance over large technology platforms compliance with new Digital and Internet regulations \- i.e. Digital Markets Act, Digital Services Act, EU AI Act. This will include identifying and assessing risks, developing testing strategies, and communicating findings to clients and stakeholders.
* Conducting in\-depth Algorithm and AI control reviews and control testing, leveraging Deloitte's proprietary methodologies and tools and by reference to emerging AI standards (such as ISO, NIST, etc).
* Developing and implementing innovative assurance approaches to address emerging risks and challenges in the rapidly evolving landscape of AI and algorithms.
* Developing and maintaining strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor and proactively identifying opportunities for new business. This includes leading client meetings, presentations, and proposal development.
* Building strong relationships and influence with pivotal stakeholders across the UK AI ecosystem; helping steer the development of the approach to AI assurance in the UK.
* Actively contributing to business development activities, including leading elements of our market activation, identifying and pursuing new opportunities, preparing proposals, and participating in marketing and networking events.
* Mentoring and developing team members, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
* Ensuring all project deliverables are undertaken in accordance with Deloitte's quality and risk management standards.
* Working effectively in diverse, cross\-service line teams, leveraging internal networks to deliver comprehensive solutions to clients. This will involve collaborating with colleagues from other service lines to deliver integrated services.

Elements of our AI Assurance activation are at a relatively early stage. We are looking for an Associate Director with the energy, vision and enthusiasm to develop the team as it grows, and drive market impact. The Associate Director will be able to contribute to shaping the vision for the role and their team.


**Connect to your skills and professional experience**

To qualify for this opportunity, you must have the following skills:


**Essential**


* Extensive knowledge and experience in the regulatory landscape surrounding algorithms and AI (e.g. EU AI Act, Digital Services Act, Digital Markets Act, Online Safety Act, MIFID II RTS 6, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, SS1/23 etc.). Ability to interpret and apply these regulations and standards to practical scenarios and advise clients on compliance strategies.
* Proven ability to lead and manage complex risk and control assessments, specifically within the context of algorithms and AI. Experience should encompass both design and operating effectiveness testing of controls, ideally within an IT or data\-driven environment.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience delivering high\-quality reports and presentations to senior stakeholders, effectively communicating complex technical information to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience leading and managing complex, multi\-faceted projects, including the development of project plans, resource allocation, budget management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience of developing and executing business strategy.
* Experience of market activation, business development and winning work in the market, with a proven track record of building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* Experience of influencing stakeholders at C\-suite and non\-executive levels, and managing client expectations whilst delivering projects on time and within budget
* Proven ability to mentor and develop junior team members, fostering a high\-performing and collaborative team environment.
* Advanced analytical capabilities (including proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word).
* Highly motivated and results\-oriented individual with a proven ability to work independently and as part of a team. Demonstrated initiative and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* An ability to communicate complex concepts in a simple way.

**Desirable**


Additional desirable experience includes:


* A strong network across the UK’s AI ecosystem.
* Significant experience in internal or external audit, with a focus on the design and operating effectiveness testing of IT controls. Experience with regulatory audits is a plus.
* Experience in projects related to algorithms or technology control enhancement and regulatory change, either within a professional services firm or in industry. This includes experience with control framework enhancements related to algorithms or AI.
* Experience in coding (e.g., Python, Java) or advanced data modelling and analytics techniques.
* Use of Gen\-AI to drive enhanced efficiency in delivery and design of services.

**Connect to your business \- Audit \& Assurance**


We know it’s not just about the numbers. Often, we let the technology take care of those. It’s about the creative and collective thinking or our people. That’s where the true insight is found. We’re redefining the future of audit. Come join us.


**Assurance**


Businesses need to be resilient and transparent in their reporting to build trust and confidence. Assurance practitioners play a key role in achieving this through independent review and challenge of management’s views on a range of regulatory and reporting requirements, whether financial, operational or compliance in nature.


**Personal independence**

Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further details as you progress through the recruitment process, or you can contact the Independence team upon request.


**Connect with your colleagues**

“At Deloitte you will be joining a diverse team of experts capable of delivering meaningful and durable change for both our clients and our profession. Innovation is key for us, underpinned by audit quality.” \- Deloitte employee, Audit \& Assurance


**Our hybrid working policy**


You’ll be based in London with hybrid working.


At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.


**Our commitment to you**

Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.


We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.


Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world\-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.


**Connect to your next step**

A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.


Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose\-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

title: Business Administration Assistant

Aero Dynamik is a growing aviation services business specialising in professional aircraft detailing and technical cleaning within the business aviation sector.

As the company continues to develop and expand, we are looking for an organised, confident and proactive **Business Administration Assistant** to support our management team and wider business operations.

This is not simply a traditional administration role. We are looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of tasks and is comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

The Role

The Business Administration Assistant will provide day\-to\-day administrative and coordination support across the company.

You will work with different areas of the business, helping to organise information, prepare documentation, coordinate priorities, monitor outstanding actions and ensure tasks are followed through to completion.

A key part of the role is being able to **receive a request, understand what is required, establish its priority and take ownership of delivering it**.

We are particularly interested in someone who has a **creative and solution\-focused mindset**. We want someone who is prepared to think differently, suggest improvements and find practical ways of getting things done rather than simply waiting for instructions.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Managing and responding to emails, enquiries and day\-to\-day business requests professionally and promptly.
* Providing administrative support to Directors, Managers and the wider team.
* Managing multiple tasks and priorities while ensuring deadlines are achieved.
* Preparing and updating reports, spreadsheets, presentations and company documentation.
* Producing professional documents for internal and customer use.
* Monitoring outstanding actions and following up with the relevant people to ensure completion.
* Supporting daily and weekly business planning activities.
* Assisting with internal meetings, including preparing information, actions and follow\-up requirements.
* Maintaining accurate and organised electronic records and documentation.
* Supporting quality assurance and administrative compliance checks.
* Checking documentation for accuracy, completeness and presentation.
* Assisting with internal communications and coordination between different areas of the business.
* Supporting the organisation and maintenance of company systems and information.
* Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and ways of working.
* Taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through from initial request to completion.

Systems \& Technology

**Your Work**  

  

In this role, you will:


* Be accountable for driving measurable sourcing outcomes, strengthening supplier partnerships, and enabling technology initiatives across the Ascendiun Family of Companies by
* Serve as a strategic sourcing advisor to technology and business leaders, translating enterprise objectives into clear sourcing strategies, negotiation plans, and executable contracting approaches
* Influence demand, supplier selection, and spend decisions to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, risk reduction, and value creation through supplier rationalization, market leverage, and economies of scale
* Analyze supply markets, commercial models, technology trends, and supplier capabilities to identify best\-fit sources that balance price, capability, resiliency, compliance, innovation, and long\-term enterprise value

* Structure and negotiate scalable commercial models, including outcome\-based pricing, consumption\-based commitments, elastic capacity, milestone\-based delivery, indexed rate cards, reserved capacity, renewal protections, and cloud optimization constructs
* Enable cloud, digital, AI, and technology transformation initiatives by negotiating timely, commercially sound software, data, services, and technology agreements that support business continuity and speed to value
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, Finance, Risk, Compliance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve contract issues involving intellectual property, data protection, cybersecurity, regulatory obligations, audit rights, service levels, indemnities, limitations of liability, and business continuity
* Guide stakeholders from intake through signature by clarifying requirements, building complete sourcing packages, developing well\-defined statements of work, securing required approvals, and maintaining audit\-ready documentation

title: Director of Performance Media
description:
At Backbone, we live by the mantra that passion drives results. We partner with leading lifestyle brands to drive growth through integrated marketing and strategic communications. We work with brands we believe in and pair our teammates with brands matching their interests and expertise. When you join our team of smart, driven marketers, you’ll become part of an extended work family, drawn together by a passion for the outdoors and doing great work for great brands.

**The Job**


The Director of Performance Media leads our performance paid media practice and the client relationships that depend on it, with a particular focus on ecommerce and DTC brands. You will own cross\-channel paid media strategy across paid social, paid search, retail media, programmatic and emerging channels, and you will lead the people who build and run it. This is a senior seat. You set the standard the work is measured against, you sit across the table from client executives, and you are accountable for whether the media investment actually moves the business.


The job does not stop at acquisition. You will connect media spend to customer economics, working in contribution margin, payback period and LTV:CAC rather than platform\-reported ROAS, and you will partner with lifecycle and retention teams so the customers we buy are worth buying. When a client’s CFO asks what the marketing budget bought them, you are the person who answers.


The ideal candidate has seen this from both sides. You have led accounts at an agency and you have carried a number inside a brand, or you have worked closely enough with brand\-side finance to think the way they think. You are a critical thinker who is proactive and decisive, you build teams that outlast your tenure, and you treat AI\-driven buying tools as something to steer rather than something to trust blindly. Signal keeps degrading, platforms keep consolidating and automation keeps absorbing the manual work. Staying ahead of that shift, and bringing the team with you, is pivotal to the success of this position.


Over time, this role will carry direct management responsibility for a team of growth media practitioners and is accountable for their workload, development and career growth.

**The Work**

* Own growth media strategy for a portfolio of ecommerce and DTC clients, and stand behind the recommendations with clear rationale
* Serve as the senior growth media voice in the client relationship, counseling marketing and executive leadership through annual planning, quarterly business reviews and budget decisions
* Frame media investment in the language of the client’s business: contribution margin, payback period, customer lifetime value and profit
* Build forecasts, scenario plans and zero\-based budgets, then hold the work accountable to them
* Own cross\-channel budget allocation across paid social, paid search, programmatic, retail media, and emerging channels, moving spend toward what’s working
* Partner with the Analytics team to set the measurement standard for growth media at Backbone, including incrementality testing, media mix modeling and how we reconcile both with platform reporting
* Partner with Analytics to design and read geo\-lift, holdout and platform conversion\-lift studies, and translate the results into media decisions clients can act on
* Directly and indirectly manage, mentor and develop a team of growth media practitioners, including workload, performance and career paths
* Hire for the practice and build the bench as the book of business grows
* Connect acquisition to retention, partnering with lifecycle, CRM and client teams so paid investment compounds after the first order
* Collaborate with Paid Social Team to direct the creative testing agenda with Backbone creative and client creative teams, including hypothesis, volume and iteration, and deliver honest reads on what won and why
* Partner with digital operations on measurement infrastructure, including server\-side tracking, conversions APIs and clean data feeds into the attribution stack
* Build the playbooks, benchmarks and templates the rest of the Media team runs on for growth media clients
* Contribute to new business by scoping, pitching and presenting growth media approaches to prospective clients
* Own account health, scope and profitability alongside account leadership, and say so early when the work and the fee no longer match
* Manage platform and vendor partner relationships, and evaluate new buying and measurement tools before we put a client’s budget behind them
* Represent Backbone’s point of view on growth media in client forums, industry conversations and published work

title: Administrative Assistant, Engagement Programs
description:
**About AIChE**


AIChE, founded in 1908, is a professional society of more than 60,000 chemical engineers in 110 countries. Its members work in corporations, universities, and government, using their knowledge of chemical processes to develop safe and useful products for the benefit of society. AIChE fosters and disseminates chemical engineering knowledge, assists the professional and personal growth of its members, and applies the expertise of its members to address societal needs and improve the quality of life. Through its varied programs, AIChE continues to be a focal point for information exchange on the frontiers of chemical engineering research in such areas as energy, sustainability, biological and environmental engineering, nanotechnology, and chemical plant safety and security.

**Position Summary**


We are seeking an Administrative Assistant to support the development and implementation of AIChE’s professional and student conferences. The Administrative Assistant will play a key role in the development and growth of AIChE’s smaller conferences and symposia, with an emphasis supporting day\-to\-day administrative tasks associated with conference program planning, such as sending and tracking speaker invitations, abstract management, competition coordination, and website updates. * Managing and updating conference webpages

Projects could include leading small events, participation/leadership in volunteer task forces or management of other engagement program\-related tasks or assignments

* Outstanding time management and organizational skills a must

* Ability to analyze data and organize in an engaging and informative presentation

* Must be comfortable contacting volunteers, motivate and direct activities without direct authority

* Proficient in MS Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

**Educational \& Work Experience Requirements**

* Prior conference program organization or project management experience a plus
* Knowledge of current trends in Chemical Engineering research, technology, and industry, a plus

  

**Benefits**

title: Director of Applied Research
description:
**Job Description:**
====================

**Director of Applied Research, Information Retrieval**
=======================================================

**Thomson Reuters Labs**
------------------------

**About Thomson Reuters Labs**
------------------------------

We experiment, build and deliver. Thomson Reuters Labs work across all business segments to discover what new products, services, and AI\-driven solutions we can create for our customers. With access to over 60,000 TBs of legal, regulatory, news, and tax data, we are building the next generation of AI\-powered knowledge systems that transform how professionals access, discover, and act on information.


You will join the global labs leadership team as a key leader shaping the technical vision and culture of Thomson Reuters' IR and AI research initiatives.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

As Director of Applied Research, you will define and drive the technical vision for AI\-powered search, discovery, and knowledge systems that unlock value from Thomson Reuters' unique data assets. You will combine strategic leadership with hands\-on technical depth, building a world\-class team while directly contributing to cutting\-edge IR research and production\-grade solutions.


### **Key Responsibilities**

**Define Technical Vision \& Strategy**

* Set the strategic direction for Information Retrieval research and innovation at Thomson Reuters, positioning TR as a leader in retrieval\-based AI
* Establish the technical direction for retrieval, ranking, semantic search, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic retrieval system capabilities
* Design and optimize retrieval architectures leveraging embeddings, reranking, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, and contextual retrieval techniques
* Build evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for search quality, relevance, answer quality, and real\-world business impact
* Contribute to the global TR Labs engineering strategy and methodology through adoption of emerging AI/ML technologies and industry best practices

**Build \& Lead a High\-Performing Team**

* Hire, train, and manage a highly skilled team with expertise across cloud engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, and AI research
* Mentor scientists and engineers while establishing best practices for production AI development and deployment
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning across the global labs organization
* Develop team members' technical depth in information retrieval, NLP, generative AI, and large\-scale AI systems

**Drive Production AI Solutions**

* Lead development of enterprise\-grade retrieval, ranking, NLP, and knowledge\-based AI solutions that integrate with Thomson Reuters products
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer needs and domain\-specific challenges into scalable AI applications
* Establish robust channels between Labs research and product technology organizations, enabling effective transfer of innovation to production systems
* Apply modern development practices across the entire software development lifecycle—from experimentation to deployment to operational excellence
* Demonstrate proficiency in automation, system monitoring, MLOps, and cloud\-native AI applications on AWS, Azure, or equivalent platforms

**Drive Strategy \& Business Impact**

* Proactively identify opportunities where Labs can improve the status quo or generate new business value through AI/ML innovation
* Influence the global project portfolio and investment decisions with your expertise in applied AI and domain knowledge
* Provide strategic input to product and modernization roadmaps, particularly in identifying and articulating AI\-driven opportunities
* Translate complex customer problems in legal, tax, news, and corporate domains into successful AI solutions
* Continuously question why something needs to be done and for whom, maintaining a strong customer\-centric mindset

**Be a Trusted Advisor**

* Actively engage across cross\-functional teams, sharing knowledge, valuing diverse ideas, and building relationships with technology and product leaders
* Communicate effectively—translating between research and engineering methodologies and languages
* Secure alignment and clear paths to market for AI\-powered initiatives

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

You are a recognized AI leader with deep expertise in Information Retrieval, Search, Natural Language Processing, and Generative AI. You have a proven track record of turning cutting\-edge research into production solutions that deliver measurable customer value, and you bring the rare combination of technical depth, engineering excellence, and strategic business acumen.


### **Core Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Information Retrieval, or a closely related field
* 8\+ years of industry experience building and deploying production AI systems at scale
* Proven track record of successfully taking machine learning and AI solutions from research to production\-grade software with measurable business impact
* A strong publication record in leading venues such as SIGIR, NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, KDD, WWW, or comparable conferences

**Leadership \& Team Building**

* Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and manage high\-performing teams of engineers and scientists
* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and influencing technical strategy across research, engineering, and product organizations
* An entrepreneurial mindset with confidence in making independent decisions and driving initiatives forward
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills

**Technical Expertise**  

You bring deep hands\-on experience in several of the following areas:


* **Information Retrieval \& Search** : Semantic search, ranking algorithms, retrieval optimization, search relevance, and evaluation methodologies
* **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** : Design and optimization of RAG systems, grounding techniques, and answer quality assurance
* **Agentic Retrieval Systems** : Tool\-using retrieval agents, multi\-step reasoning for search, and autonomous information discovery
* **Natural Language Processing** : Core NLP tasks including Named Entity Recognition (NER), Information Extraction, question answering, and advanced language understanding
* **Large Language Models \& Generative AI** : Prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, model evaluation, and production deployment of LLM\-based applications
* **Knowledge Graphs \& Knowledge Systems** : Design, construction, and leveraging of knowledge graphs for AI applications
* **Production AI Development** : Hands\-on experience with Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and modern MLOps practices
* **Cloud\-Native AI** : Proficiency in AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud platforms for deploying and operating AI solutions at scale
* **Emerging Technologies** : A demonstrated desire to learn and embrace new and emerging technologies in the AI/ML landscape

### **Ideal Candidate Profile**

* You understand and can translate between research and engineering languages and methodologies
* You bring a strong product mindset and understand how to translate complex customer problems into successful solutions
* You have a fundamental understanding of the SDLC and hands\-on experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript
* You are comfortable with ambiguity, creative in redirecting when reaching dead ends, and embrace continuous evolution of your skills
* You thrive in diverse, agile, and interdisciplinary environments with a strong sense of urgency

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience building enterprise search, discovery, or research\-assistance platforms
* Experience within Legal, Tax \& Accounting, Risk, Financial Services, or other complex professional domains
* Experience with hybrid search, vector databases, recommendation systems, and large\-scale retrieval platforms
* Experience deploying and operating AI solutions using Azure ML, Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or similar cloud platforms
* Experience leading large\-scale AI initiatives and building diverse, geographically distributed teams
Familiarity with MLOps frameworks, containerization, and modern DevOps practices for AI systems  
* 

  

\#LI\-SM2  



**What’s in it For You?**

* **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.

Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa;

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. title: Transit Technology Project Management Team Manager
description:
**Summary**
-----------


**Come make a difference and join team Metro!**
**Help shape how one of the nation's leading transit agencies runs on technology!**


King County Metro is building something new: a Technology Section created two years ago as part of a modern IT operating model, and still defining what it can become. We're looking for an experienced, strategic, and collaborative leader to join at this pivotal moment as our **Transit Technology Project Management Team Manager**.


In this role, you’ll lead a highly skilled team of project managers who deliver business critical technology from first concept and procurement through design, testing, implementation, and full lifecycle management. The systems they deliver keep buses moving and riders connected every day. You will also work alongside Metro Division Directors and the KCIT leadership team to shape the Metro Technology Roadmap, deciding which investments best move Metro's goals forward.


You'll represent the Transit Technology Capital Project Management group on committees, workgroups, and countywide initiatives. As a senior leader in an emerging office, you'll help define its identity, culture, and visibility across King County.


**Position Information:** This recruitment will be used to fill One (1\) Career Service, Manager – Transit Systems Development and Operationsclassification vacancy. In addition, this selection process may be used to generate an eligibility pool for future Special Duty Assignment (SDA), Term Limited Temporary (TLT), and Career Service (CS) vacancies that may occur in this classification within this workgroup. The eligibility list will be retained for 12 months from the date of posting and may be used at the discretion of the hiring authority.


**Who May Apply:** We are accepting applications from all qualified individuals including current King County employees and the general public. **Please refer to the "Supplemental Information" section of this job bulletin for the required application materials.**


**Job Duties**
--------------


Applying our **ACTIVATE** values: being Accountable, Collaborative, Timely, and Impactful; how we Value Employees; staying Accessible; building what’s Trusted; and acting Equitably, is a daily responsibility and a foundational expectation for all King County employees. As a Transit Technology Project Management Team Manager, you will:


**Leadership and Workforce Development**


* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of transit technology project managers, focusing on coaching, workforce development, and building a technologically aware and future\-ready team.
* Provide guidance and support to other supervisors and technology groups within the Technology Section, contributing to section\-wide development and performance.
* Drive outcome\-based thinking, critical analysis, and clarity in an increasingly ambiguous environment, helping teams and stakeholders make informed decisions.
* Conduct performance reviews that support staff growth and build the competencies needed to bring the broader department along in its modernization journey.
* Serve as a strategic people leader offering direction, advising stakeholders, and influencing policies rather than simply managing tasks or projects.
* Manage personnel administration including hiring, discipline, leave approvals, accommodations, workload balancing, and labor contract adherence.
* Maintain productive relationships with multiple collective bargaining units; actively engage in grievance and arbitration processes as needed.
* Intervene on complex issues or team dynamics to restore alignment, resolve conflicts, and ensure project and staff success.
* Shape and support the ongoing transformation to a modern, strategically focused technology organization with strong visibility across King County.

**Technology Strategy, Planning, and Governance**


* Contribute to Metro’s technology portfolio planning and technology budget development to ensure strategic, enterprise\-wide alignment.
* Provide expert strategic analysis to help the division address technology needs, evaluating investments, priorities, and long\-range solutions. Advise senior management on tradeoffs related to technology policies, procurement approaches, and lifecycle management strategies.
* Support executive leadership in assessing risks, organizational capacity, feasibility, and market availability of emerging technologies, especially as Metro moves towards SaaS technologies.
* Prepare and deliver compelling business cases and strategic proposals to the Project Review Board (PRB), CIO, DOT leadership, and additional oversight bodies.

**Project \& Portfolio Oversight**


* Oversee a portfolio of complex technology projects with significant capital investment appropriated from the executive council. These projects help implement enterprise platforms that support mobility services for the community.
* Own the performance metrics for such complex multi\-system development efforts, project scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, and integration across hardware, software, data, and business processes.
* Enable high performance from the team using strong project management principles including agile development methodologies to support effective delivery and rapid iteration.
* Serve as a central escalation point for evaluating risks and own escalation decisions to senior leadership.

**Procurement, Contracting, and Vendor Management**


* Oversee technology procurements and contract management, including RFP/RFQ development, negotiations, change orders, acceptance criteria, and milestone approvals. Drive improvements that help in effective project delivery.
* Collaborate closely with Procurement Services and the Prosecuting Attorney’s Office to develop negotiation strategies and assess legal and project risks.
* Evaluate vendor performance and ensure high\-quality delivery, resolving service gaps, financial impacts, and contractual challenges. Enable development and documentation of vendor management best practices for the team.

**Technology Operations \& Policy Alignment**


* Partner closely with Metro division leadership to interpret operational needs, understand system impacts, and align project management team to adopt development methodologies with operational requirements.
* Support change management efforts related to technology operations, ensuring smooth transitions as systems mature or evolve.
* Work collaboratively with leaders who develop technology\-related policies, helping shape standards and guidance that influence countywide practices and best practices that help in appropriate budgeting and resource management.
* Ensure ongoing viability and performance of technology projects across the division and to the Metro Technology Advisory Board.

**Emerging Technology \& Technical Aptitude**


* Stay current with emerging trends in transit technology, including AI, cybersecurity, autonomous vehicles, and modern cloud\-based enterprise environments.
* Apply strong technical aptitude to evaluate how emerging innovations can be incorporated into Metro’s strategic roadmap and service delivery models.
* Foster a culture of modernization, encouraging teams to adopt forward\-looking practices, modern infrastructure concepts, and system integration strategies.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Representation**


* Represent the Transit Technology Project Management team across internal and external committees, project teams, and workgroups.
* Coordinate with business leaders, IT partners, and executive stakeholders to align technology strategy with operational needs and county priorities.
**Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills**
-------------------------------------------------


**We are looking for candidates who have:**


A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.


AND


At least ten (10\) years of increasingly responsible experience in IT project management that includes analyzing, planning, designing, deploying, and implementing complex IT projects and programs related to operations and infrastructure.


AND


A minimum of five (5\) years of experience in IT management/leadership position. Managing and/or leading technical staff, developing and executing work programs, developing performance measures, setting performance expectations, and providing coaching and feedback.


OR


An equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the skills, knowledge, and abilities required to perform the role effectively.


Demonstrated knowledge and skills in:


* Enterprise\-scale complex technology project life cycles, development strategies, and management principles.
* Systems analysis, design, deployment, and implementation.
* Mass transit business operations and strategic information needs.
* IT contracting, vendor management, and procurement strategies
* Managing competing priorities and performing statistical, operational, and business analyses.
* Risk assessment and mitigation including technical, legal, financial, and organizational factors.
* Knowledge of the principles, practices and techniques of labor relations that include interest\-based or collaborative labor negotiations as well as grievance and arbitration processes.
* Human resources management, supervisory practices, and labor relations.
* Workforce planning and budget administration.
* Planning and delegating work assignments.
* Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships.
* Promoting a collaborative culture fostering engagement, innovation, development, and autonomy for staff.
* Staff development and training.
* Working with a variety of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
* Conflict resolution, problem\-solving, negotiation, and team building.
* Customer service principles and stakeholder engagement.
* Effective verbal and written communication, including complex technical translation.

Use of current office software including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and email tools.  
* 
**Highly competitive candidates will have (desired, but not required):**


* Experience with a broad range of enterprise technologies including project management tools, business systems, analytics platforms, ITSM systems, testing tools, content management, collaboration tools, system integration, cloud environments, cybersecurity, and enterprise IT standards.
* Experience working in a large public sector or governmental organization.
* Knowledge of King County Metro’s operations, mission, and policies.

**Executive Assistant and Project Coordinator (AI Proficiency)**

North End Wellness \& Counseling \| Remote \| Full\-time \| $24–$28 per hour; up to $30 for an exceptionally strong candidate

**Good people. Meaningful work. A team that values you.**

Our operations team often shares how different it feels to work at North End Wellness \& Counseling. They describe feeling heard and respected, having room to be creative and grow, and being proud of the part they play in helping people heal. We see the work behind the scenes as essential to a thriving counseling practice.

North End Wellness is a counseling center with two locations and approximately 24 clinicians. We’re adding a new member to our operations team who will work closely with the Executive Director to research options, support decisions, and move projects from ideas to completion, using practical AI skills and current technology.

Approximately 25–50% of your time will also involve answering phones, scheduling clients, and providing warm, dependable support to people seeking counseling. The balance will vary with project priorities and scheduling needs, and both are significant, ongoing parts of the position.

This role is for someone who enjoys helping people, investigating questions, and turning ideas into something that works. You may start with a conversation, a rough outline, or a partially developed project. You’ll help clarify the goal, identify what is missing, and organize the next steps. We’re looking for someone who brings curiosity, sound judgment, warmth, and pride in following through.

**What makes working at NEW different?**

* **A meaningful voice in how we work:** Our operations team is included in decisions that affect their responsibilities and encouraged to help shape our systems. You’ll have room to offer ideas, use your judgment, and make improvements within agreed priorities, with support when you need it.
* **Attention to your well\-being:** We pay attention to workload, fair compensation, clear communication, and shared responsibilities. A healthy, sustainable work experience for our team helps the whole practice function well.
* **Development beyond learning the job:** Along with training in our practice and procedures, the Executive Director regularly leads sessions on communication, decision\-making, project completion, and thoughtful AI use. As NEW grows and evolves, we want our team to grow with it.
* **Connection as part of the workday:** Regular meetings and ongoing communication keep our remote team connected. We also support time together through paid team lunches and in\-person coffee meetings when location allows.

**The job: People, projects, and problem solving**

You’ll report directly to the Executive Director and work alongside the Practice Manager and scheduling and billing staff. The Practice Manager provides operational guidance and supervision in agreed areas, including scheduling and coverage. Together, we’ll clarify priorities, responsibilities, and time for focused project work. You’ll raise competing demands early so they can be resolved.

The initial focus is North End Wellness. You’ll carry out smaller assignments and agreed project steps independently, with direction and guidance, and bring significant decisions back for review.

* **Research and decision support:** Gather reliable information, investigate existing models, compare options, and identify benefits, costs, risks, and unanswered questions. Prepare clear summaries, basic financial comparisons, and reasoned recommendations to help the Executive Director and project leads make decisions.
* **Project development and completion:** Turn discussions, transcripts, and rough ideas into usable plans and materials. Clarify the intended result, organize steps and deadlines, coordinate contributors, and follow up until work is complete. Check accuracy, test whether changes work, and confirm that the people using them understand what to do.
* **Practical AI and technology:** Use approved AI tools to research, organize information, explore alternatives, draft and refine materials, and improve workflows. Learn software, troubleshoot common problems, and help colleagues use new processes. Verify outputs and recognize when specialist help is needed.
* **Progress and follow\-through:** Keep project information organized and current, communicate progress without prompting, and flag obstacles or decisions needed early. Bring work back ready for review and address remaining issues so assignments do not stall.
* **Scheduling and client coordination:** Answer calls, arrange appointments, respond to messages, and guide clients through next steps. Maintain accurate records, communicate changes, follow up on outstanding requests, and coordinate clear handoffs with clinicians and scheduling colleagues.
* **Confidentiality and accuracy:** Protect client, employee, and business information. Follow approved AI, privacy, and security practices, check details carefully, and correct errors promptly.

**Examples of projects you might support**

* Help update and organize our operations manual using existing materials and meeting transcripts, with clear writing, useful links, and easy navigation through Google Drive.
* Support the migration of email and shared files into Google Workspace by organizing steps, documenting procedures, testing changes, and helping staff make the transition.
* Assist a clinician developing a new program, such as assessment and testing, by researching existing models, adapting ideas to NEW, and comparing practical and financial considerations.

**Who we’re looking for: Capability and character**

Both your work quality and how you work with others matter. We’re looking for:

* **Project ownership and initiative:** Experience organizing and completing work with multiple steps and contributors. Ability to create structure when an assignment is not fully mapped out, ask useful questions, and follow through while balancing daily responsibilities.
* **Research and sound judgment:** Ability to distinguish facts from assumptions, investigate causes, compare alternatives, and consider effects on people and systems. Be willing to question an approach respectfully and explain your reasoning.
* **Practical AI proficiency:** Demonstrated use of AI beyond basic drafting to explore problems, analyze information, test assumptions, and develop projects or workflows. Provide useful context, refine your approach, check sources and outputs, and apply your own judgment. Stay curious and current about useful tools while following approved confidentiality practices.
* **Google Workspace and spreadsheet skills:** Confidence using Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets to organize information and create usable documents and trackers. Ability to use basic formulas and develop clear cost or financial comparisons, making assumptions explicit and checking calculations. Comparable Microsoft Office or Excel experience is welcome, with a willingness to learn Google Workspace.
* **Technology and learning:** Resourcefulness in learning software, troubleshooting common problems, and helping others use tools effectively. Programming is not required; automation experience is welcome but optional.
* **Warm, composed communication:** Ability to listen patiently and explain next steps to callers who may be anxious or overwhelmed. Maintain appropriate boundaries and involve a clinician or supervisor when needed.
* **Attention to detail and sound judgment:** Write clearly, proofread documents, check data and scheduling accuracy, and deliver work that others can use confidently. Handle confidential information carefully and consistently.
* **Collaboration and accountability:** Bring honesty, kindness, and respect. Welcome feedback, own mistakes, and care about colleagues’ experience working with you.

Relevant experience may come from executive support, operations, project coordination, implementation, or other settings. Healthcare experience is welcome; we provide practice\-specific training.

**What success looks like**

The Executive Director receives clear information for decisions and can hand off agreed work with confidence. Projects move forward with consistent follow\-through, obstacles are raised early, and finished work is accurate and usable. Clients receive timely, thoughtful scheduling support, and colleagues know where things stand.

**Pay, benefits, and practical details**

* **Pay:** $24–$28 per hour based on relevant experience and demonstrated skills, with up to $30 considered for an exceptionally strong candidate. Future increases are based on experience and performance. Full\-time W\-2 employment, generally 40 paid hours weekly, on our standard payroll schedule.
* **Schedule:** Generally Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain Time, with a one\-hour unpaid lunch, unless otherwise agreed.
* **Equipment provided:** Computer, printer, and two monitors supplied by NEW.
* **Retirement:** IRA with a 3% employer match, subject to plan eligibility and terms.
* **Wellness \& Growth Bonus:** Estimated annual amounts of $1,100 for less than 3 years of service, $2,200 for 3 to under 6 years, $3,200 for 6 to under 9 years, and $4,300 for 9 years onward, based on hours worked, length of service, and program terms.
* **Performance bonus:** Annual maximums of $500 in years 1–2, $1,000 in years 3–4, and $1,500 in year 5 onward, based on contribution, reliability, and impact, subject to eligibility and performance review.

**Working remotely: The setup you’ll need**

* **Location:** Boise and Meridian area applicants preferred; candidates throughout the United States welcome if available for the Mountain Time schedule.
* **Private, undisturbed workspace:** A dedicated home office must protect calls, screens, and documents under NEW’s HIPAA and security requirements and allow uninterrupted availability for calls, meetings, and projects.
* **Space and internet:** Room for the supplied computer, printer, and two medium to large monitors, plus reliable high\-speed internet supporting calls, video meetings, and work systems.

**How to apply: Your cover letter matters**

Please send your resume and a cover letter written specifically for this opportunity to dmcidaho@gmail.com. Tell us what interests you about North End Wellness and how your experience fits both the project work and client scheduling responsibilities. Include specific examples of:

* A project you helped develop and followed through to completion, including your contribution and the outcome.
* How you used AI to solve a problem, support a decision, or improve a workflow, and how you checked the results.
* Your experience with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, or comparable technology, along with client or customer communication.

**Applications with generic cover letters, or without a cover letter, will not be considered.**

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief, fictional project exercise before an interview. AI use is welcome in the exercise; we’re interested in your judgment, approach, and ability to verify the result.

We look forward to getting to know you, what you’re looking for in your next job, and what you have to offer.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

**As our hiring team is international, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English to ensure it can be reviewed by all stakeholders.**



**Work where work matters.**

 We are a global technology group built for what's next, offering high calibre professionals the platform for high stakes work, the kind of work that defines an entire career. When you join us, you're not just taking on projects, you're solving problems that don't even have answers yet.
   

  





 You will join an exclusive roster of talent that global leaders, including Google, Snap, Diageo, PayPal, and Jaguar Land Rover call when deadlines seem impossible, when others have already tried and failed, and when the solution absolutely has to work.
   

  





 Forget routine consultancy. You will operate where technology, design, and human behaviour meet to deliver tangible outcomes, fast. This is work that leaves a mark, work you'll be proud to tell your friends about.
   

  





 We are looking for a Lead Visual Designer to join our delivery center in Buenos Aires. 
   

  





 We look for people who embody:
 



**Innovation** 
 to solve the hardest problems.
 



 ‍
 **Accountability** 
 for every result.
 



 ‍
 **Integrity** 
 always.
   

  




**About The Role**
****Role Overview****

 We're looking for a Lead Visual Designer who loves pushing their thinking and taking it through to production. You'll flex in your role from pitching ideas to crafting web experiences to ensuring successful delivery. You know how to make people fall in love with an idea, and have the technical craft to turn that vision into world\-class designs that resonate across surfaces \- from marketing platforms and digital products to next\-generation, multimodal AI experiences.
   

  





 While this is primarily a maker role that will see you heavily involved in the work, you'll have regular opportunities to partner closely with CDs and ACDs, be a leading voice in the day\-to\-day of projects, and gain skills and experience that will set you up the next step in your creative career.
   

  





 Above all, you're an awesome human who loves being surrounded by \- and collaborating with \- smart, talented folks in a fun, fast\-paced environment.
   

  




**As a Lead Designer at Beyond, you will**
* Deliver exceptional creative for high\-impact web platforms, seamlessly connecting product utility with powerful brand storytelling and market positioning.
* Translate bold, differentiated ideas into world\-class client\-facing deliverables, focusing on UI design, responsive frameworks, visual design systems, and interactive prototypes.
* Create compelling presentation decks and prototypes, communicating the strategic thought and "why" behind your creative choices to C\-suite clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Work fluidly with UX designers, product strategists, engineers, data scientists, and copywriters to ensure conceptual ideas are grounded in technical reality and seamless UX.
* Operate as a skilled discipline lead, championing great design amongst project teams \- and guiding more junior members of staff towards it where necessary.

* 8\+ years of experience in digital/interactive design (agency or in\-house).
* A proven track record of award\-winning design, possessing the rare ability to see the "big picture" creative hook without losing sight of product execution.
* Exceptional client\-facing presentation skills. You can visualize an idea rapidly, build an inspiring narrative around it, and pitch it with conviction.
* Deep mastery of Figma, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and responsive frameworks. You build scalable design systems, not just one\-off pages.
* Confident designing for intelligent, adaptive, and context\-aware systems. Enthusiastic about using AI creative tools to accelerate rapid concepting and prototyping.

 We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. Here's how we invest in you:

* Birthday leave

****Diversity and Inclusion****

 At Beyond we champion diversity and inclusion. We believe that a career in IT should be open to everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability or neurotype. We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings to our team, and we strive to create a fair and accessible hiring process for all.
